### MkMenu (component)

Selector: `mk-menu` · exportAs: `mkMenu`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/navigation

Import: `import { MkMenu } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Dropdown menu implementing the ARIA menu pattern (roving focus, Arrow / Home
/ End / typeahead, Enter/Space to activate). Attach it to a trigger with the
`mkMenuTriggerFor` directive; the trigger controls opening and positioning.

The panel is rendered in the browser top layer via `MkAnchoredPanel`, so
it is never clipped by an ancestor's `overflow`/`transform` and always flips
back on-screen near a viewport edge.

```html
<button mkButton [mkMenuTriggerFor]="menu">Actions</button>
<mk-menu #menu>
  <mk-menu-item (action)="edit()">Edit</mk-menu-item>
  <mk-menu-item danger (action)="del()">Delete</mk-menu-item>
</mk-menu>
```

**Submenus.** Point an item at a nested menu with `[mkSubmenuFor]`; declare
the nested `<mk-menu>` anywhere inside the parent menu. The submenu opens
beside its item on hover (after a short delay), on ArrowRight / Enter /
Space / click, and closes with ArrowLeft or Escape (returning focus to the
item) — only that level, per the APG menu pattern. Activating any leaf item
closes the whole chain. In RTL the submenu opens on the left and the arrow
keys swap.

```html
<mk-menu #menu>
  <mk-menu-item [mkSubmenuFor]="exportMenu">Export</mk-menu-item>
  <mk-menu #exportMenu>
    <mk-menu-item (action)="csv()">CSV</mk-menu-item>
    <mk-menu-item (action)="pdf()">PDF</mk-menu-item>
  </mk-menu>
</mk-menu>
```

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open(trigger: HTMLElement, focus?: boolean \| "first" \| "last", placement?: MkPlacement): void` | Open the menu anchored to `trigger`. `focus` picks the item that receives focus once the panel is painted: `true`/`'first'` for the first enabled item, `'last'` for the last (ArrowUp on a menu button, per the APG menu-button pattern), `false` to leave focus where it is (mouse open). `placement` overrides the default `bottom-start` (submenus pass `right-start` / `left-start`). |
| `openAt(x: number, y: number, restoreFocusEl?: HTMLElement): void` | Open the menu at viewport coordinates — e.g. a right-click point from a `contextmenu` event. Positioning (and flip/shift back on-screen) is handled by `MkAnchoredPanel` via the point anchor. Focus moves to the first item; `restoreFocusEl` (when provided) regains focus on close. |
| `close(restoreFocus?: boolean): void` | Close this menu (and any submenu open under it); optionally restore focus to the trigger — for a submenu that is the item it hangs off. |
| `closeAll(restoreFocus?: boolean): void` | Close the whole menu chain from the root down — what activating a leaf item does, wherever in the tree it sits. Focus returns to the root trigger when `restoreFocus` is set. |
| `closeChildren(keep?: MkMenu): void` | Close every submenu open under this menu, except `keep`. |
| `toggle(trigger: HTMLElement, focusFirst?: boolean): void` | Toggle open/closed from a trigger. |
| `focusFirstItem(): void` | Move focus to the first enabled item. Used by the trigger when the menu is already open (e.g. ArrowDown after a mouse open), so arrow keys always reach the items even though focus never left the trigger. |
| `focusLastItem(): void` | Move focus to the last enabled item (ArrowUp from the trigger). |
| `containsTarget(node: Node \| null): boolean` | Whether `node` lives inside this menu's panel or any submenu open under it. Submenu panels are separate top-layer elements, so a plain `contains` on the parent panel would treat clicks in them as outside. |
| `itemHovered(item: MkMenuItem): void` | An item was hovered: close sibling submenus so only the hovered branch stays open (the item opens its own submenu after a delay). |
| `submenuPlacement(): MkPlacement` | Placement for a submenu hanging off `item`, honouring text direction. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panelId` | `string` | Stable id for `aria-controls` on the trigger. |
| `opened` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether the menu is currently open. |
| `ariaLabel` | `WritableSignal<string \| undefined>` | Accessible label for the menu (defaults via the trigger if unset). |
| `isSubmenu` | `boolean` | Whether this menu is a submenu of another `mk-menu`. Submenus open sideways, close a single level on Escape, and swap ArrowLeft/ArrowRight. |

### MkMenuItem (component)

Selector: `mk-menu-item`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/navigation

Import: `import { MkMenuItem } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

An item within an `<mk-menu>`. Renders as an ARIA `menuitem` with an optional
icon slot (`[mkMenuItemIcon]`), disabled and danger states, and either emits
`action` or navigates when `href` is set. Activating closes the menu.

With `[mkSubmenuFor]` pointing at a nested `<mk-menu>` the item becomes a
submenu trigger instead: it shows a chevron, exposes `aria-haspopup` /
`aria-expanded`, opens the submenu beside itself on hover, ArrowRight,
Enter, Space or click, and never emits `action`.

```html
<mk-menu-item (action)="rename()">
  <svg mkMenuItemIcon>…</svg> Rename
</mk-menu-item>
<mk-menu-item danger (action)="remove()">Delete</mk-menu-item>
<mk-menu-item href="/help">Help</mk-menu-item>
<mk-menu-item [mkSubmenuFor]="more">More</mk-menu-item>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevent selection and focus. |
| `danger` | `boolean` | `false` | Destructive styling (e.g. Delete). |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` |  | When set, activating the item navigates here. |
| `mkSubmenuFor` | `MkMenu \| undefined` | `undefined` | A nested `mk-menu` this item opens as a submenu. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `void` | Emitted when the item is activated (not for disabled or submenu items). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `activate(event?: Event): void` |  |
| `openSubmenu(focus: boolean): void` | Open the submenu beside this item; `focus` moves focus to its first item. |
| `focusEl(): void` | Move DOM focus to this item (roving focus). |
| `contains(node: Node \| null): boolean` | Whether `node` lives inside this item. |
| `text(): string` | Lowercased text content, used for typeahead matching. |

### MkNavGroup (component)

Selector: `mk-nav-group`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/command-nav

Import: `import { MkNavGroup } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

A titled section within an `<mk-nav-list>` — the "MAIN" / "SETTINGS" groupings
common in admin/CMS sidebars. Static by default; set `collapsible` to make
the label a toggle that expands/collapses its items (`aria-expanded` +
region). In a collapsed icon rail the label becomes a divider.

```html
<mk-nav-list>
  <mk-nav-group label="Main">
    <mk-nav-item label="Dashboard" href="/" />
  </mk-nav-group>
  <mk-nav-group label="Settings" collapsible>
    <mk-nav-item label="Team" href="/team" />
  </mk-nav-group>
</mk-nav-list>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Section title. |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` | `false` | Make the label a toggle that shows/hides the items. |
| `expanded` (two-way) | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the section is expanded (two-way; only meaningful when collapsible). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expandedChange` | `boolean` | Emits when `expanded` changes (two-way binding). |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `regionId` | `string` | Id of the items region (for `aria-controls`). |

### MkNavItem (component)

Selector: `mk-nav-item`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/command-nav

Import: `import { MkNavItem } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

A single sidebar entry: icon slot (`[mkNavIcon]`), label, optional badge and
active state. Renders a link when `href` is set, otherwise a button that
emits `action`. If it contains nested `<mk-nav-item>`s it becomes an
expandable disclosure (`aria-expanded`). Collapses to an icon in a collapsed
list, exposing the label as a tooltip — and because a sub-list can't be shown
at rail width, a parent item there emits `action` (navigate) instead of
toggling, so it never becomes a dead button.

```html
<mk-nav-item label="Reports" active href="/reports" badge="3">
  <svg mkNavIcon>…</svg>
</mk-nav-item>
<mk-nav-item label="Settings">
  <svg mkNavIcon>…</svg>
  <mk-nav-item label="Team" href="/team" />
</mk-nav-item>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible label. Also used as the tooltip when collapsed. |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` |  | Link target. Renders an anchor instead of a button. |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the current page (`aria-current="page"`). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable interaction. |
| `badge` | `string \| number \| undefined` |  | Optional badge (count or short text). |
| `expanded` (two-way) | `boolean` | `false` | Whether nested children are expanded (two-way). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expandedChange` | `boolean` | Emits when `expanded` changes (two-way binding). |
| `action` | `void` | Emitted when a button-style item is activated. |

### MkNavList (component)

Selector: `mk-nav-list`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/command-nav

Import: `import { MkNavList } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Sidebar navigation list. Hosts `<mk-nav-item>`s and, when `collapsed`, drives
them into an icon-only rail (labels hidden, exposed via `title` tooltips).
Designed to sit inside the `mkAppSidebar` slot of `<mk-app-shell>`.

```html
<mk-nav-list [collapsed]="collapsed()">
  <mk-nav-item label="Dashboard" href="/" active>
    <svg mkNavIcon>…</svg>
  </mk-nav-item>
</mk-nav-list>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | Collapse items to icon-only. Read by descendant `MkNavItem`s. |

### MkPageHeader (component)

Selector: `mk-page-header`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/structure

Import: `import { MkPageHeader } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

PageHeader — the standard heading block at the top of an admin/CMS page: an
optional breadcrumb, a page title with optional description and inline meta
(badges/status), a right-aligned actions cluster, and an optional tab row
beneath. Everything but the title/description is projected, so it composes
with `mk-breadcrumb`, `mk-tabs`, buttons, badges, etc.

Slots: `[mkPageHeaderBreadcrumb]`, `[mkPageHeaderMeta]` (beside the title),
`[mkPageHeaderActions]` (right), `[mkPageHeaderTabs]` (below).

```html
<mk-page-header heading="Articles" description="Manage your published posts.">
  <mk-breadcrumb mkPageHeaderBreadcrumb …></mk-breadcrumb>
  <mk-badge mkPageHeaderMeta tone="success">Live</mk-badge>
  <div mkPageHeaderActions>
    <button mkButton variant="outline">Import</button>
    <button mkButton>New article</button>
  </div>
</mk-page-header>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `string` | `''` | The page title (rendered as an `<h1>`). |
| `description` | `string` | `''` | Supporting description under the title. |

### MkPagination (component)

Selector: `mk-pagination`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/navigation

Import: `import { MkPagination } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Page navigation with previous/next controls and numbered pages that collapse
to ellipses for large ranges. Provide either `total` (+ `pageSize`) or a
direct `pageCount`. `page` is 1-based and two-way bindable.

```html
<mk-pagination
  [total]="240"
  [pageSize]="20"
  [(page)]="page"
  (pageChange)="load($event)"
/>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `total` | `number` | `0` | Total number of items (used with `pageSize` when `pageCount` is unset). |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `10` | Items per page. |
| `pageCount` | `number` | `0` | Explicit page count; overrides `total`/`pageSize` when > 0. |
| `page` (two-way) | `number` | `1` | Current 1-based page (two-way). |
| `siblingCount` | `number` | `1` | Number of page buttons to keep on each side of the current page. |
| `boundaryCount` | `number` | `1` | Number of page buttons pinned at each end. |
| `label` | `string` | `this.i18n.paginationLabel` | Accessible label for the navigation landmark. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pageChange` | `number` | Emits when `page` changes (two-way binding). |

### MkScrollArea (component)

Selector: `mk-scroll-area`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/structure

Import: `import { MkScrollArea } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

ScrollArea — a scroll container that hides the native scrollbar and renders
its own themed overlay bars (à la Radix ScrollArea). The projected content
scrolls inside a real, keyboard-focusable viewport, so native wheel / arrow
scrolling keeps working; the custom bars are decorative (`aria-hidden`) and
draggable.

```html
<mk-scroll-area maxHeight="20rem">
  <p>…lots of content…</p>
</mk-scroll-area>
```

Set `orientation` to `horizontal` / `both` for a horizontal bar, and
`hideDelay` to auto-hide the bars after inactivity (`0` = always visible).

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxHeight` | `string` | `''` | Optional CSS max-height for the viewport, e.g. `'20rem'`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name for the scrollable viewport. When set, the viewport is exposed as a labelled `region` landmark — recommended, since the viewport is keyboard-focusable (`tabindex="0"`) and a focusable scroll container should have an accessible name. When empty, no role / label is added. |
| `orientation` | `MkScrollAreaOrientation` | `'vertical'` | Which axes render a custom bar. |
| `hideDelay` | `number` | `1000` | Auto-hide the bars after this many ms of inactivity (`0` = always on). |

### MkSplitButton (component)

Selector: `mk-split-button`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/buttons

Import: `import { MkSplitButton } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

SplitButton — a primary action with an attached menu of alternatives.
The main segment emits `action`; the chevron segment is a menu button
(`mkMenuTriggerFor`) for the `mk-menu` passed in `[menu]`, with the full
keyboard model of the menu trigger (ArrowDown / Enter / Space open and focus
the first item, ArrowUp the last, Escape closes).

Both segments share `variant`, `tone` and `size`; `disabled` disables both,
`loading` shows the main segment's spinner and disables the chevron.

```html
<mk-split-button [menu]="saveMenu" tone="primary" (action)="save()">
  Save
</mk-split-button>
<mk-menu #saveMenu>
  <mk-menu-item (action)="saveAs()">Save as…</mk-menu-item>
  <mk-menu-item (action)="saveTemplate()">Save as template</mk-menu-item>
</mk-menu>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menu` (required) | `MkMenu` |  | The menu the chevron segment opens. |
| `variant` | `MkVariant` | `'solid'` | Visual treatment shared by both segments. |
| `tone` | `MkTone` | `'primary'` | Semantic color tone shared by both segments. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size shared by both segments. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable both segments. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Spinner on the main segment; the menu segment is disabled meanwhile. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to the container width (the main segment grows). |
| `type` | `"submit" \| "button"` | `'button'` | `type` of the main segment — `submit` to submit the enclosing form. |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.moreActions` | Accessible name of the chevron segment. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `void` | Emitted when the main segment is activated (not while disabled/loading). |

### MkSplitter (component)

Selector: `mk-splitter`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/structure

Import: `import { MkSplitter } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Splitter — two resizable panes with a draggable, keyboard-operable separator
(ARIA `separator` with `aria-valuenow`). `horizontal` places the panes
side-by-side (a vertical handle); `vertical` stacks them (a horizontal
handle). The start pane's size is a two-way `position` model (percent).

Project the panes with `mkSplitterStart` / `mkSplitterEnd`:
```html
<mk-splitter [(position)]="split" [min]="20">
  <nav mkSplitterStart>…</nav>
  <main mkSplitterEnd>…</main>
</mk-splitter>
```
Drag the handle, or focus it and use Arrow keys (Home/End jump to min/max).

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `MkSplitterOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` = side-by-side; `vertical` = stacked. |
| `position` (two-way) | `number` | `50` | Two-way position of the separator = start-pane size, in percent (0–100). |
| `min` | `number` | `10` | Minimum start-pane size (percent). |
| `max` | `number` | `90` | Maximum start-pane size (percent). |
| `step` | `number` | `5` | Keyboard resize increment (percent). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable resizing. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.resizePanes` | Accessible label for the separator. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `positionChange` | `number` | Emits when `position` changes (two-way binding). |

### MkStep (component)

Selector: `mk-step`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/stepper

Import: `import { MkStep } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

A single step + its content panel. Declared inside `<mk-stepper>`; the
projected content becomes the step body while `label` (and optional
`description`) render in the step header.

`completed` is a two-way model so a parent can gate a `linear` stepper:
`<mk-step label="Details" [(completed)]="detailsValid()">`.

```html
<mk-stepper linear>
  <mk-step label="Account" [completed]="form.valid">…</mk-step>
  <mk-step label="Payment" optional>…</mk-step>
</mk-stepper>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Title shown in the step header. |
| `description` | `string` | `''` | Optional secondary line under the label. |
| `optional` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the step optional (skippable in a `linear` stepper). |
| `completed` (two-way) | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the step is complete (two-way; drives `linear` gating + the ✓). |
| `hasError` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the error state in the header (e.g. failed validation). |
| `editable` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow returning to this step after it is completed. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completedChange` | `boolean` | Emits when `completed` changes (two-way binding). |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headerId` | `string` | Stable id for the header button (wires `aria-labelledby`). |
| `panelId` | `string` | Stable id for the panel (wires `aria-controls`). |
| `active` | `WritableSignal<boolean>` | Whether this step is currently selected. Set by the parent `MkStepper`. |

### MkStepper (component)

Selector: `mk-stepper`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/stepper

Import: `import { MkStepper } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Stepper — walks a user through an ordered sequence of `<mk-step>`s with an
accessible header rail (ARIA `tablist` + roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End
navigation) and a single visible panel.

In `linear` mode a step is only reachable once every preceding required
(non-`optional`) step reports `completed`. Drive completion from your form
state and move with the `next()` / `previous()` / `reset()` API or by
clicking a reachable header.

```html
<mk-stepper #s linear [(selectedIndex)]="index">
  <mk-step label="Account" [completed]="accountValid()">…</mk-step>
  <mk-step label="Address" [completed]="addressValid()">…</mk-step>
  <mk-step label="Review">…</mk-step>
</mk-stepper>
<button mkButton (click)="s.previous()">Back</button>
<button mkButton (click)="s.next()">Next</button>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedIndex` (two-way) | `number` | `0` | Zero-based index of the active step (two-way). |
| `orientation` | `MkStepperOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | Header rail orientation. |
| `linear` | `boolean` | `false` | Enforce sequential completion before a step becomes reachable. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedIndexChange` | `number` | Emits when `selectedIndex` changes (two-way binding). |
| `selectionChange` | `number` | Emits the newly selected index whenever the active step changes. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `isReachable(index: number): boolean` | Whether a step can be selected. In linear mode every earlier required step must be completed; a completed step is reachable only when `editable`. |
| `next(): void` | Advance to the next reachable step, if any. |
| `previous(): void` | Return to the previous step, if any. |
| `reset(): void` | Reset to the first step and clear every step's completed flag. |

### MkTab (component)

Selector: `mk-tab`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

### MkToolbar (component)

Selector: `mk-toolbar`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/structure

Import: `import { MkToolbar } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Toolbar — a horizontal action bar: content flows on the start side, anything
marked `mkToolbarEnd` is pushed to the end. Handy above tables and lists for
a title/search on the left and actions on the right.

The projected controls are ordinary tab stops (no roving focus), so this is a
layout container, not an ARIA `toolbar` widget.

```html
<mk-toolbar bordered aria-label="Users actions">
  <strong>Users</strong>
  <span mkToolbarEnd>
    <button mkButton variant="outline">Export</button>
    <button mkButton>New user</button>
  </span>
</mk-toolbar>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bordered` | `boolean` | `false` | Wrap the bar in a themed, bordered surface. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name (also promotes the bar to an ARIA `group`). |

### MkTree (component)

Selector: `mk-tree`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/tree

Import: `import { MkTree } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Tree — renders hierarchical data following the ARIA tree pattern
(`role="tree"` / `treeitem` with `aria-level`, `aria-expanded`,
`aria-selected`). Supply `nodes`; expansion is managed internally.

Keyboard: Up/Down move between visible rows, Right expands (or steps into the
first child), Left collapses (or steps out to the parent), Home/End jump, and
Enter/Space toggles expansion and selects (when `selectable`). A single
roving tabindex keeps the whole tree one tab stop.

```html
<mk-tree selectable [nodes]="tree" [(selected)]="picked"
  (selectionChange)="onPick($event)" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | `readonly MkTreeNode[]` | `[]` | The hierarchical data to render. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow choosing a node (adds selection styling + `aria-selected`). |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name for the tree. |
| `selected` (two-way) | `unknown` | `null` | Two-way selected value (a node's `value`, or the node itself if unset). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedChange` | `unknown` | Emits when `selected` changes (two-way binding). |
| `selectionChange` | `unknown` | Emits the selected value whenever the selection changes. |
| `nodeToggle` | `MkTreeNode` | Emits a node whenever it is expanded or collapsed. |

Marks projected content as the header of an `<mk-accordion-item>`. Use when

### MkFabAction (directive)

### MkMenuTrigger (directive)

Selector: `[mkMenuTriggerFor]` · exportAs: `mkMenuTrigger`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/navigation

Import: `import { MkMenuTrigger } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

Turns its host button into a trigger for an `<mk-menu>`. Wires
`aria-haspopup="menu"` / `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`, toggles on click,
opens on ArrowDown / Enter / Space (focusing the first item) and on ArrowUp
(focusing the last item, per the APG menu-button pattern), and closes on
Escape. When the menu is already open — e.g. after a mouse click, which
deliberately leaves focus on the trigger — ArrowDown moves focus to the
first item and ArrowUp to the last, so the keyboard is never dead.

```html
<button mkButton [mkMenuTriggerFor]="menu">Actions</button>
<mk-menu #menu>…</mk-menu>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mkMenuTriggerFor` (required) | `MkMenu` |  | The menu instance to control. |

### MkCommand (interface)

Import: `import { MkCommand } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

A single actionable entry in the `MkCommandPalette`.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Stable unique id. |
| `label` | `string` | Text shown (and the primary search target). |
| `group`? | `string \| undefined` | Optional section heading this command is grouped under. |
| `hint`? | `string \| undefined` | Secondary text shown after the label. |
| `icon`? | `string \| undefined` | Name of a registered icon (see `MkIconRegistry`). |
| `keywords`? | `string \| undefined` | Extra search terms (not shown). |
| `shortcut`? | `string \| undefined` | Display-only shortcut hint, e.g. `⌘S`. |
| `disabled`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Disable the command (skipped by keyboard, not runnable). |
| `run`? | `(() => void) \| undefined` | Invoked when the command is chosen. |

### MkTreeNode (interface)

Import: `import { MkTreeNode } from '@mk-kit/ui/navigation';`

A node in an `MkTree`. `children` makes it expandable.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Text shown for the node. |
| `value`? | `unknown` | Value bound to the selection when the node is chosen (defaults to the node). |
| `children`? | `MkTreeNode[] \| undefined` | Child nodes; a non-empty array makes the node a parent (expandable). |
| `disabled`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Disable selection/toggling of this node (still focusable). |
| `expanded`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Expand this node initially. |
| `icon`? | `string \| undefined` | Optional leading glyph (any short string / emoji). |

type MkFabPosition = | 'bottom-end' | 'bottom-start' | 'top-end' | 'top-start' | 'static';

## @mk-kit/ui/forms

### MkAutocomplete (component)

Selector: `mk-autocomplete` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkAutocomplete } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Autocomplete — an accessible text input that suggests options as the user
types, implementing the ARIA combobox (`aria-autocomplete="list"`) pattern
with a popup listbox.

Filtering is built in (`contains` / `startsWith`); set `filterMode="none"`
and drive `options` yourself from the `search` output for async/server-side
suggestions. Typing arbitrary text is allowed unless `requireSelection` is
set, in which case the field clears on blur if it doesn't match an option.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so it
works with `[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]`. When nested in an
`mk-form-field` it inherits size, label, hint/error and required wiring.

```html
<mk-autocomplete placeholder="Search users"
  [options]="filtered()"
  filterMode="none"
  (search)="query.set($event)"
  [(value)]="userId" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly MkAutocompleteOption[]` | `[]` | The list of suggestions. Update it from `search` for async sources. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder shown when the input is empty. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `filterMode` | `MkAutocompleteFilterMode` | `'contains'` | How the option list is filtered against the typed text. |
| `minChars` | `number` | `0` | Only open the list once this many characters have been typed. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a loading row instead of "no results" (for async fetches). |
| `requireSelection` | `boolean` | `false` | Clear the input on blur unless the text matches a selectable option. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `this.i18n.noResults` | Message shown when there are no matching options. |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown` | `null` | Two-way selected value (the `value` of the chosen option, or `null`). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `search` | `string` | Emits the current input text on every keystroke — drive async loading. |
| `optionSelected` | `MkAutocompleteOption` | Emits the option whenever one is committed by click or Enter. |

### MkButtonToggleGroup (component)

Selector: `mk-button-toggle-group` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkButtonToggleGroup } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

ButtonToggleGroup — a segmented control grouping one or more
`mk-button-toggle` items into a single, keyboard-operable selection.

In single-select mode (default) the group is an ARIA `radiogroup`: exactly
one item is selected, Arrow keys move and select, and the selected item is
the tab stop. Set `multiple` to allow any number of items — the group
becomes a toolbar of independent `aria-pressed` buttons.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model. In
single mode `value` is the chosen item's `value`; in multiple mode it is an
array of the selected values.

```html
<mk-button-toggle-group [(value)]="view" aria-label="View">
  <mk-button-toggle value="grid">Grid</mk-button-toggle>
  <mk-button-toggle value="list">List</mk-button-toggle>
</mk-button-toggle-group>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow selecting any number of items (toolbar of `aria-pressed` buttons). |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size, applied to every item. Ignored inside an `mk-form-field`. |
| `tone` | `MkTone` | `'primary'` | Semantic color tone used for the selected fill. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole group. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force the invalid visual + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name for the group (recommended). |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown` | `null` | Two-way selected value. Single mode: the chosen item's `value` (or `null`). Multiple mode: an array of selected values. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `isSelected(toggle: MkButtonToggle): boolean` | Whether a given item is part of the current selection. |
| `tabIndexFor(toggle: MkButtonToggle): number` | `0` for the item that owns the tab stop, `-1` for the rest. |
| `select(toggle: MkButtonToggle): void` | Toggle (multiple) or set (single) the selection for an item. |
| `onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent, toggle: MkButtonToggle): void` |  |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effectiveSize` | `Signal<MkSize>` | The size actually applied (the form field's when nested). |

### MkCardNumberInput (component)

Selector: `mk-card-number-input` · exportAs: `mkCardNumberInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/payment

Import: `import { MkCardNumberInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

CardNumberInput — a payment-card number field that groups digits with the
detected network's layout (16-digit `0000 0000 0000 0000`, Amex
`0000 000000 00000`, Diners `0000 000000 0000`), shows the brand as a
badge, and validates the complete number with the Luhn checksum.

The form value is the raw digit string (no spaces). `brand()` exposes the
detected network (also via `(brandChange)`), and `valid()` reports
`true`/`false` for a complete number passing/failing Luhn and `null` while
empty or incomplete; invalid styling engages after the field was touched.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-card-number-input [(ngModel)]="cardNumber" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `showBrand` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the detected brand as a badge inside the field. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'0000 0000 0000 0000'` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way card number, digits only (no spaces). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `brandChange` | `MkCardBrand \| null` | Emits whenever the detected brand changes. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `cardNumber` for a number failing the Luhn checksum (which includes a half-typed one). An empty value passes; compose with `Validators.required` to reject it. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | `Signal<MkCardBrand \| null>` | The detected card network, `null` while unrecognised. |
| `valid` | `Signal<boolean \| null>` | `true` for a complete number passing Luhn, `false` for a complete number failing it, `null` while empty or incomplete. |

### MkCascader (component)

Selector: `mk-cascader` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkCascader } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Cascader — a select whose choices are a hierarchy shown as side-by-side
columns (region → country → city, category → subcategory, org unit → team).
Each pick opens the next column; picking a leaf commits the whole path.

The value is the **path** of option values (`['eu', 'pl', 'krk']`) by
default, or just the leaf's value with `valueMode="leaf"`. Parents are only
selectable with `selectParents` (a click on one then commits, and its
children stay reachable).

Keyboard: Up / Down move within a column, Right opens the children, Left
goes back, Enter / Space selects, typing jumps to a label, Escape closes.
`expandTrigger="hover"` opens columns on pointer hover as well as click.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way `value` model.

```html
<mk-cascader [options]="regions" [(value)]="location" placeholder="Where?" clearable />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly MkCascaderOption[]` | `[]` | The hierarchy to choose from. |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown` | `null` | Two-way value: the path of values (default) or the leaf value (`valueMode="leaf"`). |
| `valueMode` | `"path" \| "leaf"` | `'path'` | Bind the full path of values (default) or only the chosen option's value. |
| `selectParents` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow committing a parent option (click / Enter on it) instead of leaves only. |
| `expandTrigger` | `"click" \| "hover"` | `'click'` | Open the next column on click (default) or also on pointer hover. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.selectPlaceholder` |  |
| `separator` | `string` | `' / '` | Text between the labels of the chosen path. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `change` | `unknown` | Emitted after the user commits or clears a value. |

### MkCodeEditor (component)

Selector: `mk-code-editor` · exportAs: `mkCodeEditor` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/forms

Import: `import { MkCodeEditor } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

CodeEditor — a lightweight, dependency-free code field with syntax
highlighting, JSON validation and pretty-printing. A `<textarea>` provides
editing and a synced highlight layer sits behind it, so it stays fully
accessible (real textarea semantics, `aria-invalid`, form-field wiring)
without pulling in a heavyweight editor.

With `language="json"` it validates on every change (exposing an inline error
+ `(validate)` output) and offers `format()` to pretty-print. Ideal for a CMS
`json` field or plugin/settings JSONB editing.

Keyboard: Tab inserts `tabSize` spaces; press Escape then Tab to move focus
out (so it is never a keyboard trap). Implements `ControlValueAccessor` over a
string value with a two-way `value` model.

```html
<mk-code-editor #editor language="json" [(value)]="config" [rows]="10" />
<button mkButton (click)="editor.format()">Format</button>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language` | `MkCodeLanguage` | `'plaintext'` | Language for highlighting + validation. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Render read-only (still focusable/selectable). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling when used standalone. |
| `rows` | `number` | `8` | Visible rows (minimum height). |
| `lineNumbers` | `boolean` | `true` | Show a line-number gutter. |
| `tabSize` | `number` | `2` | Number of spaces inserted by Tab. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `false` | Soft-wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `''` | Accessible label when used standalone (no form field). |
| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way editor content. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `validate` | `MkCodeValidity` | Emits the content validity whenever it changes (JSON only). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `parsed(): unknown` | The parsed JSON value, or `undefined` when empty / invalid / plaintext. |
| `format(): void` | Pretty-print valid JSON with `tabSize` indentation. No-op otherwise. |

### MkCurrencyInput (component)

Selector: `mk-currency-input` · exportAs: `mkCurrencyInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/payment

Import: `import { MkCurrencyInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

CurrencyInput — a money/amount field that formats itself with
`Intl.NumberFormat`: thousands grouping live as the user types, the
currency symbol as a fixed prefix/suffix (per locale), fraction digits
padded to the currency's convention on blur (`1234,5` → `1 234,50 zł`).
The form value is always a plain `number` (or `null` when empty) — the
locale formatting never leaks into the data.

`currency` takes an ISO 4217 code; omit it for a plain grouped decimal.
`locale` defaults to the runtime locale. `decimals` overrides the
currency's fraction digits; `min`/`max` clamp on blur.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-currency-input currency="PLN" [(ngModel)]="price" />
<mk-currency-input currency="USD" [min]="0" [(value)]="budget" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currency` | `string` | `''` | ISO 4217 currency code (`PLN`, `USD`, …). Empty = plain decimal. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | BCP 47 locale for separators/symbol; defaults to the runtime locale. |
| `decimals` | `number \| null` | `null` | Max fraction digits; defaults to the currency's convention (else 2). |
| `min` | `number \| null` | `null` | Clamp the value to at least this on blur. |
| `max` | `number \| null` | `null` | Clamp the value to at most this on blur. |
| `allowNegative` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow a leading minus sign. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `value` (two-way) | `number \| null` | `null` | Two-way numeric value (`null` when empty). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `number \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `min` / `max` against the `[min]` and `[max]` inputs, using the same error shapes as `Validators.min` / `Validators.max`. |

### MkFileUpload (component)

Selector: `mk-file-upload` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/forms

Import: `import { MkFileUpload } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

FileUpload — an accessible click-or-drag dropzone with multi-file support,
type/size/count validation, image thumbnails and per-file progress.

Provide an `uploadFn` to stream each accepted file to your backend (it
reports progress and resolves/rejects); with `autoUpload` (on by default when
an `uploadFn` is set) files upload as soon as they are accepted. Without one,
the component just validates + tracks files and emits `filesSelected` for you
to handle. The tracked list is a two-way `files` model so you can reset it.

Keyboard: the dropzone is a button — Enter/Space opens the native picker.
Rejections are announced through a polite live region.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and `Validator`, so it drops into a
reactive form like any other control. The form value is `File[]` by default
(`[valueFormat]="'item'"` publishes the tracked `MkUploadFile[]` instead),
and `accept` / `maxSize` / `maxFiles` are enforced as validation errors as
well as at pick time — a list written in from the model side is checked too.

```html
<mk-file-upload accept="image/*" multiple [maxSize]="5_000_000"
  [uploadFn]="upload" (filesSelected)="onFiles($event)" [(files)]="files" />

<mk-file-upload formControlName="attachments" accept=".pdf" [maxFiles]="3" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | `string` | `''` | Native `accept` filter, e.g. `image/*` or `.pdf,.doc`. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow selecting more than one file. |
| `maxSize` | `number` | `0` | Maximum size per file in bytes (0 = unlimited). |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | `0` | Maximum number of files kept (0 = unlimited). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling when used standalone. |
| `label` | `string` | `this.i18n.dropzoneLabel` | Primary dropzone prompt. |
| `hint` | `string` | `''` | Secondary hint under the prompt (e.g. accepted types / size). |
| `hideList` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the built-in file list (render your own from `files`). |
| `uploadFn` | `MkUploadFn \| null` | `null` | Async upload handler. When set, files upload automatically. |
| `autoUpload` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Upload accepted files immediately. Defaults to true when `uploadFn` set. |
| `valueFormat` | `MkUploadValueFormat` | `'file'` | Shape of the value published to a bound form control. |
| `files` (two-way) | `MkUploadFile[]` | `[]` | The tracked files (two-way, so consumers can reset the list). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filesChange` | `MkUploadFile[]` | Emits when `files` changes (two-way binding). |
| `filesSelected` | `File[]` | Emits the accepted `File`s each time files are added. |
| `rejected` | `MkUploadRejection[]` | Emits rejected files with a reason. |
| `uploaded` | `MkUploadFile` | Emits a file once its upload succeeds. |
| `removed` | `MkUploadFile` | Emits a file when it is removed from the list. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Applies the same `accept` / `maxSize` / `maxFiles` rules the dropzone enforces at pick time, so a list written in from the model side — which never goes through that path — is checked too. An empty list passes; compose with `Validators.required` to reject it. |

### MkFormErrorSummary (component)

Selector: `mk-form-error-summary` · exportAs: `mkFormErrorSummary`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/forms

Import: `import { MkFormErrorSummary } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

FormErrorSummary — an accessible summary of a form's validation errors,
shown at the top of the form on a failed submit. Each entry links to its
field and focuses it on click. Following the WAI/GOV.UK pattern it is an
`alert` region and, when the surrounding form is submitted with errors,
focus moves here automatically (opt out with `[autoFocus]="false"`) so
screen-reader and keyboard users are taken straight to the problems. The
public `focus()` remains for manual flows (e.g. server-side errors).

## Automatic collection

Point `form` at a `FormGroup` and the summary walks it itself: one entry per
invalid control, worded from the `validation` i18n table (override per key
with `errorMessages`). Pass `labels` to name the fields — without an entry
the control's path is used. Entries appear once the form is submitted;
`showOn="always"` lists them as soon as they exist.

Each entry is linked to its field by locating the control in the DOM, so
`formControlName` must be a static attribute (`formControlName="email"`,
the usual form) rather than a binding.

```html
<!-- automatic -->
<form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="submit()">
  <mk-form-error-summary #summary [form]="form"
    [labels]="{ email: 'Email address', age: 'Age' }" />
  …
</form>

<!-- manual -->
<mk-form-error-summary #summary [errors]="errors()" />
…
onSubmit() { if (invalid) { this.errors.set(collect()); this.summary.focus(); } }
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors` | `readonly MkFormError[]` | `[]` | Errors to list explicitly. When non-empty this wins over `form`, so a form can mix automatic collection with server-side errors by not setting it. |
| `form` | `AbstractControl<any, any, any> \| null` | `null` | Collect errors from this control tree instead of passing them in. |
| `labels` | `Readonly<Record<string, string>>` | `{}` | Field names for automatic entries, keyed by control path. |
| `errorMessages` | `Readonly<Record<string, string \| ((err: any) => string)>> \| null` | `null` | Per-key wording for automatic entries, as on `mk-form-field`. |
| `showOn` | `"submit" \| "always"` | `'submit'` | When automatic entries appear. Defaults to after the form is submitted. |
| `summaryTitle` | `string` | `this.i18n.errorSummaryTitle` | Heading shown above the list. |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Move focus to the summary automatically when the surrounding form is submitted with errors (the WAI/GOV.UK pattern). Disable to drive focus yourself via the public `focus()`. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focus(): void` | Move keyboard focus to the summary (call after a failed submit). |

### MkFormField (component)

Selector: `mk-form-field`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/forms

Import: `import { MkFormField } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

FormField — an accessible wrapper that provides a real `<label>`, optional
hint text, error text and a required indicator for any nested control
(`input[mkInput]`, `mk-select`, `mk-checkbox`, …).

It generates stable ids (via `mkUniqueId`) and exposes them so nested
controls can wire `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby` / `aria-invalid`
automatically by injecting this component. While an error shows, the hint is
hidden and the error is announced through a `role="alert"` region.

## Automatic errors

When the projected control is bound to a form (`formControlName`,
`[formControl]` or `[(ngModel)]`) the field adopts its `NgControl` and shows
the first validation error by itself — no `[error]` binding needed. Messages
come from the `validation` i18n table and can be reworded per field with
`errorMessages`. As with `mat-error`, an error only appears once the control
is touched or dirty, or its form has been submitted; `errorOn` changes that.
`required` and the disabled styling are derived from the control too.

```html
<!-- automatic: message + required marker come from the validators -->
<mk-form-field label="Email">
  <input mkInput type="email" formControlName="email" />
</mk-form-field>

<!-- per-field wording -->
<mk-form-field label="Age" [errorMessages]="{ min: 'You must be 18 or over' }">
  <mk-number-input formControlName="age" [min]="18" />
</mk-form-field>

<!-- fully manual: an explicit [error] always wins -->
<mk-form-field label="Email" hint="We never share it." required
  [error]="emailError()">
  <input mkInput type="email" [(ngModel)]="email" />
</mk-form-field>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible field label. Rendered as a real `<label for>`. |
| `hint` | `string` | `''` | Optional helper text shown below the control (hidden while an error shows). |
| `error` | `string \| null` | `null` | Explicit error message. When non-null it overrides the automatic message derived from the projected control; `''` suppresses errors entirely. |
| `errorMessages` | `Readonly<Record<string, string \| ((err: any) => string)>> \| null` | `null` | Per-field wording for automatic errors, keyed by `ValidationErrors` key. Each value is either a fixed string or a function of the error payload. |
| `errorOn` | `"touched" \| "dirty" \| "always"` | `'touched'` | When automatic errors become visible. `touched` (the default) matches Material: after the control is touched or dirty, or the form is submitted. `dirty` waits for an actual edit; `always` shows as soon as it is invalid. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required (adds an indicator + `aria-required`). Derived from the projected control's validators when it is bound to a form. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually reflect a disabled control. Derived from the projected control when it is bound to a form. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size; nested controls inherit it. |
| `labelPosition` | `"top" \| "float"` | `'top'` | Where the label sits: above the control (default), or `float` — inside the control, sliding up once it is focused or has a value. Floating works with `mkInput` / textarea and any control bound with `ngModel` or a `formControl`; the placeholder stays hidden until the label has moved. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controlId` | `string` | Id for the nested interactive control — adopt on your control element. |
| `labelId` | `string` | Id of the `<label>` element (for `aria-labelledby`). |
| `hintId` | `string` | Id of the hint element. |
| `errorId` | `string` | Id of the error element. |
| `errorText` | `Signal<string \| null>` | The message actually rendered — an explicit `error` always wins. |
| `hasError` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether the field currently has an error. |
| `isRequired` | `Signal<boolean>` | Required either explicitly or through the bound control's validators. |
| `isDisabled` | `Signal<boolean>` | Disabled either explicitly or through the bound control. |
| `hintVisible` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether the hint should be shown (hidden while an error is present). |
| `describedBy` | `Signal<string \| null>` | Space-separated id list for a nested control's `aria-describedby`, or `null` when there is nothing to describe. |

### MkI18nInput (component)

Selector: `mk-i18n-input` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/text-inputs

Import: `import { MkI18nInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

I18nInput — one field that edits the same text in several languages.

The common alternative is stacking one input per language, which grows the
form linearly with locale count and buries the field the author actually
cares about. This shows a single input and a compact switcher, and marks
which locales already have content so nothing is silently left untranslated.

Binds a `Record<code, string>`, so it drops into reactive forms as one
control instead of a nested group:

```html
<mk-form-field label="Name">
  <mk-i18n-input formControlName="name" [locales]="locales" />
</mk-form-field>
```

```ts
locales = [
  { code: 'en', label: 'EN', name: 'English' },
  { code: 'pl', label: 'PL', name: 'Polish' },
];
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locales` | `readonly MkI18nLocale[]` | `[]` | Locales offered, in switcher order. The first is the initial tab. |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | `false` | Render a textarea instead of a single-line input. |
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Textarea rows (ignored unless `multiline`). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder for the active locale's input. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size, forwarded to the input and the switcher. |
| `requiredLocales` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Locale codes that must be filled. They get a marker in the switcher while empty, so a missing translation is visible without switching to it. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole control. |

### MkIbanInput (component)

Selector: `mk-iban-input` · exportAs: `mkIbanInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/payment

Import: `import { MkIbanInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

IbanInput — an international bank account number field: uppercases and
groups the number in blocks of four as the user types (`PL61 1090 1014 …`),
caps input at the country's exact length (65 countries built in) and
validates with the ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum.

The form value is the compact electronic format (uppercase, no spaces).
`valid()` (via `exportAs`) reports `true`/`false` for a complete number
passing/failing validation and `null` while empty or incomplete; invalid
styling engages after the field was touched.
`mkIbanValidator()` covers reactive forms.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-iban-input [(ngModel)]="account" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'PL61 1090 1014 0000 0712 1981 2874'` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way IBAN in compact electronic format (uppercase, no spaces). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `iban` for a number failing the mod-97 checksum — the same error `mkIbanValidator()` produces, so the two are interchangeable. An empty value passes; compose with `Validators.required` to reject it. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valid` | `Signal<boolean \| null>` | `true` for a complete IBAN passing the mod-97 check, `false` for a complete-but-wrong one (or an unknown country once 2+ chars are typed and the field was left), `null` while empty or still incomplete. |

### MkInput (component)

Selector: `input[mkInput], textarea[mkInput]` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/text-inputs

Import: `import { MkInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Input — enhances a native `<input>` or `<textarea>` with mk-kit theming and
a11y wiring. It is an attribute-selector component so all native semantics
and keyboard behaviour come for free; this layers on tokenised styling, aria
state and form integration.

It provides its own `ControlValueAccessor` (over the native `value`) so
`[(ngModel)]` and reactive forms write back to the DOM reliably — including
when the bound model is reset programmatically. IME composition is buffered
so `onChange` fires once per completed character, matching Angular's built-in
`DefaultValueAccessor`.

When placed inside an `mk-form-field` it automatically adopts the field's
control id (so the `<label for>` associates), `aria-describedby`,
`aria-invalid` and `aria-required`.

```html
<input mkInput type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
<textarea mkInput rows="4" [invalid]="true"></textarea>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field` (inherits it). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force the invalid visual + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |

### MkInputGroup (component)

Selector: `mk-input-group`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/text-inputs

Import: `import { MkInputGroup } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

InputGroup — wraps a native `input[mkInput]` with leading / trailing affixes
(icons, static text, compact buttons) inside one shared control frame. The
group carries the border, background and focus ring; the nested input
detects the group and drops its own chrome, so the whole assembly reads as
a single field.

Project affixes with the `mkInputPrefix` / `mkInputSuffix` attributes. Both
are optional; interactive suffixes (a clear or scan button) keep their own
focus behaviour.

Inside an `mk-form-field` the group inherits the field's size and invalid
state, and the field's label association still targets the inner input.

```html
<mk-input-group>
  <mk-icon mkInputPrefix name="search" />
  <input mkInput type="search" placeholder="Search…" />
</mk-input-group>

<mk-form-field label="Price">
  <mk-input-group>
    <input mkInput type="number" formControlName="price" />
    <span mkInputSuffix>zł</span>
  </mk-input-group>
</mk-form-field>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field` (inherits it). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force the invalid visual when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually reflect a disabled inner control. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effectiveSize` | `Signal<MkSize>` | The size the group (and its nested input) renders at. |
| `isInvalid` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether the group renders the invalid frame. |

### MkListbox (component)

Selector: `mk-listbox` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkListbox } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Listbox — a standalone, always-visible selection list (the ARIA `listbox`
pattern) for one or many values: settings panes, "choose a template"
pickers, side-by-side assignments, any place a dropdown would hide choices
the user should see at once.

Keyboard: Up / Down move, Home / End jump, PageUp / PageDown skip ten,
type to jump to a label, Enter / Space select (toggle when `multiple`),
Shift+Arrow / Shift+click extend a range, Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all. Focus
stays on the list (`aria-activedescendant`). With `filterable`, a search
box above the list narrows it by label or description.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way `value` model — a single
value, or an array when `multiple`.

```html
<mk-listbox [options]="plans" [(value)]="plan" ariaLabel="Plan" />
<mk-listbox multiple filterable [options]="people" [(ngModel)]="reviewers" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly MkListboxOption[]` | `[]` | The rows to choose from. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow several values; the model becomes an array. |
| `filterable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a search box that narrows the list by label / description. |
| `filterPlaceholder` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` |  |
| `selectionFollowsFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Single-select only: moving with the arrow keys selects immediately (default `true`); `false` requires Enter / Space to commit. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Accessible name when there is no visible label / form field. |
| `ariaLabelledby` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` |  |
| `emptyText` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | Text shown when no option matches the filter. |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown` | `null` | Two-way value: one value, or an array when `multiple`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `change` | `unknown` | Emitted after the user changes the selection (not on programmatic writes). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focus(): void` | Focus the list. |

### MkMentionPanel (component)

Selector: `mk-mention-panel`

Import: `import { MkMentionPanel } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Suggestion listbox for `MkMention`. Created dynamically by the
directive and wired imperatively right after creation: the directive hands
it read-only signals (options, active index, caret anchor point) plus plain
callbacks, so the panel re-renders reactively without `setInput` churn.

The `<ul>` is promoted to the top layer by `mkAnchoredPanel` and positioned
at the caret point; this host element stays empty in place.

Not intended for direct use — the public API is the `[mkMention]` directive.

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `optionId(index: number): string` |  |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `anchorPoint` | `Signal<{ x: number; y: number; }>` | Caret point (viewport px) the panel is anchored to. |
| `anchorEl` | `HTMLElement \| undefined` | The mention control itself — passed as the anchored panel's element anchor so pointerdowns inside the control don't count as "outside" dismissals (the point anchor still wins for positioning). |

### MkMultiSelect (component)

Selector: `mk-multi-select` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkMultiSelect } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

MultiSelect — an accessible combobox that commits **multiple** values,
rendering each selection as a removable chip inside the control. Implements
the ARIA combobox + multiselectable listbox pattern.

Filtering is built in (`contains` / `startsWith`); set `filterMode="none"`
and drive `options` from the `search` output for async / server-side sources.
Selected options are remembered even after they leave the `options` list, so
chips keep their labels across async pages.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` over an **array** value and exposes a
two-way `value` model, so it works with `[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and
`[(value)]`. When nested in an `mk-form-field` it inherits size, label,
hint/error and required wiring.

Keyboard: type to filter, Up/Down to move, Home/End to jump, Enter/Space to
toggle the active option, Backspace on an empty query removes the last chip,
Escape closes. The dropdown renders in the top layer via
`MkAnchoredPanel` so it is never clipped by a container.

```html
<mk-multi-select placeholder="Add tags"
  [options]="tagOptions()"
  [(value)]="tags" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly MkMultiSelectOption[]` | `[]` | The list of options to choose from. Update from `search` for async. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder shown when no value is selected. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `filterMode` | `MkMultiSelectFilterMode` | `'contains'` | How the option list is filtered against the typed text. |
| `minChars` | `number` | `0` | Only open the list once this many characters have been typed. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a loading row instead of "no results" (for async fetches). |
| `max` | `number` | `0` | Maximum number of selections (0 = unlimited). |
| `closeOnSelect` | `boolean` | `false` | Close the dropdown after each selection. Default keeps it open. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `this.i18n.noResults` | Message shown when there are no matching options. |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown[]` | `[]` | Two-way selected values. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown[]` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `search` | `string` | Emits the current query text on every keystroke — drive async loading. |
| `optionAdded` | `MkMultiSelectOption` | Emits the option whenever one is added. |
| `optionRemoved` | `unknown` | Emits the value whenever a selection is removed. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMaxItems` when more options are selected than `[max]` allows. |

### MkNumericKeypad (component)

Selector: `mk-numeric-keypad` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/touch-keys

Import: `import { MkNumericKeypad } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Numeric keypad — a touch-first 3×4 digit pad for PIN entry, quantity entry
and money amounts (POS-style). `ControlValueAccessor` + two-way `value`
model; the value is a **string** in `pin` mode (leading zeros preserved)
and a **number | null** in `quantity`/`amount` mode.

- `pin`: masked echo row by default; `(submit)` fires automatically when
  `length` digits are entered.
- `quantity`: integer entry; the bottom-left key clears.
- `amount`: decimal entry (value uses `.`; the echo shows
  `decimalSeparator`); capped at `fractionDigits` fraction digits.

A physical keyboard works anywhere inside the pad: digits, Backspace,
Delete (clear), Enter (submit) and the decimal separator. Arrow keys move
between the on-screen keys (roving tabindex).

```html
<mk-numeric-keypad mode="pin" [length]="4" (submit)="unlock($event)" />
<mk-numeric-keypad mode="quantity" [min]="1" [(value)]="qty" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `MkNumericKeypadMode` | `'quantity'` | Entry mode. Decides the value type and the bottom-left key. |
| `length` | `number` | `4` | PIN length (`pin` mode only). Reaching it emits `submit`. |
| `min` | `number \| null` | `null` | Lower bound reported through the validator (`quantity`/`amount`). |
| `max` | `number \| null` | `null` | Upper bound reported through the validator (`quantity`/`amount`). |
| `mask` | `boolean` | `true` | Mask the echo row in `pin` mode. Default `true`. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the echo row above the keys. Default `true`. |
| `decimalSeparator` | `string` | `','` | Echo-row separator for `amount` mode. The VALUE always uses `.`. |
| `fractionDigits` | `number` | `2` | Max fraction digits accepted in `amount` mode. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the pad. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.numericKeypadLabel` | Accessible label for the pad. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string \| number \| null` | `null` | Two-way value: `string` in `pin` mode, `number \| null` otherwise. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string \| number \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `submit` | `string \| number \| null` | Enter key / full PIN. Emits the current value. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | `pin`: reports `minlength` while the code is incomplete (empty passes — compose with `Validators.required`). `quantity`/`amount`: reports `min`/`max` against the bounds. |

### MkOnScreenKeyboard (component)

Selector: `mk-on-screen-keyboard` · exportAs: `mkOnScreenKeyboard`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/touch-keys

Import: `import { MkOnScreenKeyboard } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

On-screen keyboard — a touch QWERTY panel for kiosk/till screens where no
physical keyboard exists. Anchored below its input in the browser top layer
(via `MkAnchoredPanel`), it writes caret-aware into the target's
native value and dispatches `input` events, so `ngModel`/reactive forms
stay in sync with no extra wiring.

Pair it with the `mkOnScreenKeyboardFor` directive, which opens the panel
on focus and suppresses the OS keyboard (`inputmode="none"`):

```html
<input mkInput [mkOnScreenKeyboardFor]="kbd" />
<mk-on-screen-keyboard #kbd />
```

Layers: base (letters + digit row), shift (auto-resets after one
character) and an alternate layer (Polish diacritics + symbols in the
default `MK_KEYBOARD_LAYOUT_QWERTY_PL`); pass `layout` for other
languages. Enter inserts a newline in a `<textarea>` and emits `enter`
for single-line inputs. Keys are excluded from the tab order — physical
keyboards type into the input directly, the panel is a pointer surface.

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `MkKeyboardLayout` | `MK_KEYBOARD_LAYOUT_QWERTY_PL` | Key layout. Defaults to QWERTY with a Polish alternate layer. |
| `placement` | `MkPlacement` | `'bottom-start'` | Preferred placement relative to the input. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enter` | `void` | Enter pressed on a single-line input (textareas insert a newline instead). |
| `closed` | `void` | Emitted whenever the keyboard closes (any reason). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open(anchor: HTMLElement, target: MkOnScreenKeyboardTarget): void` | Open anchored to `anchor`, typing into `target`. |
| `close(): void` | Close the panel. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panelId` | `string` | Stable id for `aria-controls` on the trigger. |
| `opened` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether the panel is open. |

### MkOtp (component)

Selector: `mk-otp` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/text-inputs

OTP — a segmented one-time-code input: N single-character boxes with automatic

| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way concatenated value. |

### MkPhoneInput (component)

Selector: `mk-phone-input` · exportAs: `mkPhoneInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/phone-postal

Import: `import { MkPhoneInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

PhoneInput — an international telephone field: a searchable country-prefix
dropdown (flag + dial code) next to a national-number input that formats
itself with the selected country's mask as the user types.

The form value is either a single E.164 string (`"+48601234567"`, default)
or a structured object (`valueFormat="parts"`) carrying the country, dial
code and national number separately; both modes read back either shape and
`null` when empty. Pasting a full international number (`+44…`) into the
number field switches the country automatically.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes two-way `value` and `country`
models, so `[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms, `[(value)]` and `[(country)]` all
work.

```html
<mk-phone-input [(ngModel)]="phone" country="PL" />
<mk-phone-input valueFormat="parts" [preferredCountries]="['PL','DE','CZ']"
  [(value)]="phoneParts" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `countries` | `readonly MkPhoneCountry[]` | `MK_PHONE_COUNTRIES` | The selectable country set (defaults to the built-in list). |
| `preferredCountries` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | ISO codes pinned, in order, to the top of the dropdown. |
| `valueFormat` | `"e164" \| "parts"` | `'e164'` | Shape of the form value: an E.164 string or a structured object. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder for the national-number field. |
| `country` (two-way) | `string` | `'US'` | Two-way selected ISO country code. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string \| MkPhoneValue \| null` | `null` | Two-way form value (`string` in `e164` mode, `MkPhoneValue` in `parts`). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `countryChange` | `string` | Emits when `country` changes (two-way binding). |
| `valueChange` | `string \| MkPhoneValue \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

### MkPostalCodeInput (component)

Selector: `mk-postal-code-input` · exportAs: `mkPostalCodeInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/phone-postal

Import: `import { MkPostalCodeInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

PostalCodeInput — a postal/ZIP code field that masks, uppercases and
validates itself for the given `country` (35+ built-in formats: `PL`
`00-000`, `US` `00000[-0000]`, `CA` `A0A 0A0`, `NL` `0000 AA`, …).
Free-format countries (e.g. `GB`) skip the mask and validate against the
national pattern instead, normalising the inward-code space on blur.

The placeholder defaults to a valid example for the country. `valid()`
(via `exportAs`) reports `true`/`false` for a complete/incomplete code and
`null` when empty or the country is unknown; invalid styling engages after
the field is touched.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-postal-code-input country="PL" [(ngModel)]="zip" />
<mk-postal-code-input [country]="form.value.country" [(value)]="zip" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | `string` | `'US'` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose format applies. |
| `formats` | `readonly MkPostalFormat[]` | `MK_POSTAL_FORMATS` | The format table (defaults to the built-in set) — extend to add countries. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder; defaults to a valid example for the country. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way formatted value (e.g. `00-950`, `K1A 0B1`). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `postalCode` for a code not matching `[country]`'s format — the same error `mkPostalCodeValidator()` produces. Empty values and countries without a built-in format pass. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valid` | `Signal<boolean \| null>` | `true`/`false` for a complete/incomplete code, `null` when empty or the country has no known format. |

| `isChecked(radio: MkRadio): boolean` | True when `radio` matches the group's current value. |

### MkRepeater (component)

Selector: `mk-repeater` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/forms#repeater

Import: `import { MkRepeater } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Repeater — the schema-friendly editable list: renders one instance of a
consumer-projected row template per item, with add / remove / (optional)
drag-and-drop + keyboard reorder built in.

`items` is a two-way model and the component also implements
`ControlValueAccessor` over `T[]`, so it drops into template-driven and
reactive forms alike. **Every mutation produces a new array** — the
consumer's array is never mutated in place.

Rows are tracked by **item object identity** (stable across the repeater's
immutable array copies), so removing a middle row keeps the following rows'
DOM — and any in-progress input state — intact. Consequently, arrays of
primitives with duplicate values (e.g. `['a', 'a']`) are not supported
directly: wrap each value in an object (`{ value: 'a' }`) so every row has
a distinct identity.

With `reorderable`, each row gets a drag handle wired through the dnd
module's touch-safe handle-based configuration (a swipe on the row body
still scrolls the page). Reordering also works by keyboard: focus the
handle (or the row) and press Space/Enter to pick up, arrows to move,
Space/Enter to drop, Escape to cancel. Each completed reorder is announced
via `MkLiveAnnouncer`.

```html
<mk-repeater [(items)]="rows" [min]="1" [max]="10" reorderable
             [factory]="newRow" addLabel="Add row">
  <ng-template mkRepeaterRow let-item let-i="index">
    <input mkInput [(ngModel)]="item.name" />
  </ng-template>
  <ng-template mkRepeaterEmpty>No rows yet.</ng-template>
</mk-repeater>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (two-way) | `T[]` | `[]` | The rows (two-way). Every mutation sets a **new** array. |
| `factory` | `() => T` | `() => ({}) as T` | Creates the item appended by the add button. Default: `{}` cast to `T`. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | Minimum number of rows — remove buttons disable at (or below) it. |
| `max` | `number` | `0` | Maximum number of rows (0 = unlimited) — the add button disables at it. |
| `reorderable` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable per-row drag handles (pointer + keyboard reorder). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole control (add, remove and reorder). |
| `addLabel` | `string` | `''` | Add-button caption. Defaults to the i18n `repeaterAddRow` string. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `itemsChange` | `T[]` | Emits when `items` changes (two-way binding). |
| `added` | `{ item: T; index: number; }` | Emitted after the add button appended a factory-made item. |
| `removed` | `{ item: T; index: number; }` | Emitted after a row was removed. |
| `moved` | `{ from: number; to: number; }` | Emitted after a row was reordered (drag or keyboard). |
