### MkSignaturePad (component)

Selector: `mk-signature-pad` · exportAs: `mkSignaturePad` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/signature

Import: `import { MkSignaturePad } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

SignaturePad — a canvas the user draws a signature on (pointer, touch or
pen). Strokes are captured as smoothed polylines, rendered crisp on hi-DPI
screens and re-drawn losslessly when the pad resizes. The form value is a
PNG data-URL of the drawing (`null` while empty), so it drops straight into
an `<img>`, a form post or an upload.

A Clear control resets the pad (also available as `clear()`); `isEmpty()`
reports whether anything is drawn. Programmatic values (`writeValue`,
`[value]`) are painted onto the canvas as an image.

Drawing is inherently pointer-based; pair the pad with an alternative flow
(e.g. a typed-name checkbox) where WCAG requires a keyboard equivalent.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-signature-pad [(ngModel)]="signature" />
<img [src]="signature" alt="Captured signature" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | `2` | Stroke width in CSS pixels. |
| `height` | `number` | `160` | Pad height in CSS pixels (width follows the container). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string \| null` | `null` | Two-way PNG data-URL of the signature (`null` while empty). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `cleared` | `void` | Emits when the pad is cleared (via the button or `clear()`). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clear(): void` | Clear the drawing (and the form value). |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isEmpty` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether nothing is drawn yet. |

### MkSubmitInput (component)

Selector: `mk-submit-input` · exportAs: `mkSubmitInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/forms

Import: `import { MkSubmitInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

SubmitInput — a short text entry and its action button rendered as one
connected control: the "type a code and apply it" pattern (discount codes,
gift cards, invite codes, newsletter sign-up, quick search).

The button is disabled while the value is empty or blank, shows a spinner
while `loading` and emits `submitted` with the **trimmed** value on
click or on Enter.

## Enter never submits the surrounding form

This control is normally dropped inside a bigger form (a checkout, a
settings page), where triggering that form's submit would be a bug. So the
action button is a `type="button"` and, while `submitOnEnter` is on, the
Enter keydown is `preventDefault()`-ed — implicit form submission never
fires. Set `submitOnEnter="false"` to restore the native behaviour and let
Enter reach the enclosing form.

## Button content

The button is configured, not projected: `buttonLabel` sets its text.
Passing `buttonIcon` (a registered `MkIcon` name) switches it to the
square icon-only variant, where `buttonLabel` becomes its `aria-label` — so
the action always has an accessible name.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-submit-input
  [(value)]="code"
  buttonLabel="Apply"
  [loading]="applying()"
  placeholder="SUMMER10"
  clearable
  (submitted)="apply($event)"
/>

<!-- icon-only, inside a field -->
<mk-form-field label="Search">
  <mk-submit-input buttonIcon="search" buttonLabel="Search" [(ngModel)]="q" />
</mk-form-field>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole control (input + button). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name for the inner input when the control is used outside an `mk-form-field` (inside one, the field's `<label>` wins). Defaults to the button's caption. |
| `type` | `string` | `'text'` | Native `type` of the inner input (`text`, `search`, `email`, …). |
| `autocomplete` | `string` | `'off'` | Native `autocomplete` hint for the inner input. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way value. `submitted` emits it trimmed; the model keeps what was typed. |
| `buttonLabel` | `string` | `''` | Button text — or, with `buttonIcon`, the icon button's `aria-label`. |
| `buttonIcon` | `string` | `''` | Registered icon name; switches the button to the icon-only variant. |
| `buttonVariant` | `MkVariant` | `'solid'` | Button visual treatment. |
| `buttonTone` | `MkTone` | `'primary'` | Button colour tone. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner in the button and blocks submitting while an action runs. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear affix while the value is non-empty. |
| `submitOnEnter` | `boolean` | `true` | Submit on Enter, without submitting an enclosing `<form>`. Turn it off to let Enter bubble to the form as the browser normally would. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `submitted` | `string` | Emits the current value, trimmed, when the action is triggered. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `submit(): void` | Emit `submitted` with the trimmed value, when the control allows it. |
| `clear(): void` | Clear the value and return focus to the input. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputId` | `string` | Id of the inner input — the `<label for>` target inside an `mk-form-field`. |

### MkSwitch (component)

Switch — a toggle with `role="switch"` and an animated knob. Operable with

### MkTagInput (component)

Selector: `mk-tag-input` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkTagInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

TagInput — a freeform token input: type a value and press Enter (or a
separator) to add it as a removable chip. Backspace on an empty field removes
the last tag, and pasting a delimited string adds several at once. Unlike
`mk-multi-select` the tags are not drawn from a fixed option list. Implements
`ControlValueAccessor` + a two-way `value` model of `string[]`.

```html
<mk-tag-input placeholder="Add tags…" [(value)]="tags" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (two-way) | `string[]` | `[]` | Two-way list of tags. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder shown in the text field. |
| `max` | `number` | `0` | Maximum number of tags (0 = unlimited). |
| `allowDuplicates` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow the same tag more than once. |
| `addOnBlur` | `boolean` | `false` | Commit the pending text as a tag when the field loses focus. |
| `separators` | `readonly string[]` | `[',']` | Extra characters that commit the pending text (Enter always does). A pasted string is split on these too. Default: comma. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string[]` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `added` | `string` | Emitted when a tag is added. |
| `removed` | `string` | Emitted when a tag is removed. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMaxItems` when more tags are present than `[max]` allows. |

### MkTaxIdInput (component)

Selector: `mk-tax-id-input` · exportAs: `mkTaxIdInput` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/payment

Import: `import { MkTaxIdInput } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

TaxIdInput — a business tax-identifier field that masks and validates itself
for the given `country` (`PL` NIP `000-000-00-00`, `DE` USt-IdNr., `CZ` DIČ,
`IT` Partita IVA, `SK` IČ DPH). Poland's NIP is checksum-verified; the other
built-ins are shape-verified.

Like `MkIbanInput`, the form value is the **compact** identifier (digits
only, e.g. `1234563218`) while the field *displays* it masked
(`123-456-32-18`) — so what is stored is what an API or invoice expects, and
`writeValue()` accepts either form. The placeholder defaults to a valid
example for the country. `valid()` (via `exportAs`) reports `true`/`false`
for a complete identifier passing/failing validation and `null` while empty,
still incomplete or the country is unknown; invalid styling engages after
the field was touched. `mkTaxIdValidator()` covers reactive forms.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and exposes a two-way `value` model, so
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]` all work.

```html
<mk-tax-id-input [(ngModel)]="nip" />
<mk-tax-id-input [country]="form.value.country" [(value)]="taxId" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | `string` | `'PL'` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose format applies. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Placeholder; defaults to a valid example for the country. |
| `value` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Two-way identifier in compact form (digits only, e.g. `1234563218`). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `taxId` for an identifier not matching `[country]`'s format or failing its checksum — the same error `mkTaxIdValidator()` produces, so the two are interchangeable. Empty values and unknown countries pass; compose with `Validators.required` to reject an empty one. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valid` | `Signal<boolean \| null>` | `true` for a complete identifier passing its format (and checksum), `false` for a complete-but-wrong one, `null` while empty, still shorter than the mask allows, or the country has no known format. |

### MkTransferList (component)

Selector: `mk-transfer-list` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkTransferList } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

TransferList — a dual list box (a.k.a. pick list) for moving items between an
**available** list and a **selected** list, e.g. assigning roles or
permissions. The user checks rows in one list then clicks the middle move
buttons (or presses Enter on a row) to shuttle them across.

Implements `ControlValueAccessor` over an **array** value (the values in the
selected list) and exposes a two-way `value` model, so it works with
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]`. When nested in an
`mk-form-field` it inherits size and label wiring.

Keyboard: each listbox is a single tab stop (roving tabindex). Arrow Up/Down
and Home/End move between rows, Space toggles a row's check and Enter moves
it to the opposite list.

```html
<mk-transfer-list filterable
  [items]="allRoles()"
  [(value)]="assignedRoles"
  availableLabel="All roles"
  selectedLabel="Assigned" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly MkTransferItem[]` | `[]` | The full set of items to shuttle between the two lists. |
| `availableLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.available` | Heading for the left (available) list. |
| `selectedLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.selected` | Heading for the right (selected) list. |
| `filterable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a search box over each list. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole control. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown[]` | `[]` | Two-way values currently in the selected (right) list. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown[]` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `change` | `unknown[]` | Emits the new selected values whenever items are moved. |

### MkTreeSelect (component)

Selector: `mk-tree-select` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection

Import: `import { MkTreeSelect } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

TreeSelect — a form field whose popover contains a hierarchical
`MkTree`. The trigger shows the selected node's label (or a
placeholder); opening it reveals a selectable tree rendered in the top layer
via `MkAnchoredPanel`, so it is never clipped. Choosing a node sets the
value to that node's `value` (or the node itself when `value` is unset),
closes the panel and restores focus to the trigger. Implements
`ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way `value` model.

```html
<mk-tree-select [nodes]="tree" [(value)]="picked" clearable />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodes` | `readonly MkTreeNode[]` | `[]` | The hierarchical data to render in the panel. |
| `value` (two-way) | `unknown` | `null` | Two-way selected value (a node's `value`, or the node itself if unset). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.selectPlaceholder` | Placeholder shown when nothing is selected. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear button when a value is selected. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `unknown` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueId` | `string` | Id of the rendered value/placeholder span, appended to `aria-labelledby`. |

### MkMention (directive)

Selector: `textarea[mkMention], input[mkMention]` · exportAs: `mkMention`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/selection#mention

Import: `import { MkMention } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Mention / hashtag autocomplete for a **native** `<textarea>` or text
`<input>`. Typing a trigger character (`@`, `#`, …) at the start of a word
opens a top-layer suggestion panel anchored at the caret; picking an option
replaces the trigger-plus-query with the completed mention and dispatches an
`input` event so `ngModel`/reactive-forms bindings stay in sync.

The element keeps its native textbox semantics — no `role="combobox"` — and
follows the ARIA activedescendant pattern while the panel is open
(`aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`,
`aria-activedescendant`).

Filtering is built in (`contains` / `startsWith` over label + value); set
`mentionFilter="none"` and drive `mentionOptions` from the `mentionSearch`
output for async/server-side suggestions (`mentionLoading` keeps the panel
open with a spinner while results are in flight).

```html
<textarea mkMention
  [mentionTriggers]="['@', '#']"
  [mentionOptions]="users"
  (mentionSelect)="onPick($event)"
></textarea>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mentionTriggers` | `readonly string[]` | `['@']` | Single characters that start a mention session. |
| `mentionOptions` | `readonly MkMentionOption[]` | `[]` | The suggestion pool. Update it from `mentionSearch` for async sources. |
| `mentionFilter` | `MkMentionFilterMode` | `'contains'` | How suggestions are filtered against the typed query. |
| `mentionLoading` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the panel open with a loading row while async results are pending. |
| `mentionInsert` | `((option: MkMentionOption, trigger: string) => string) \| null` | `null` | Builds the text inserted for a picked option. Defaults to `` `${trigger}${option.label} ` `` (note the trailing space). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mentionSearch` | `MkMentionSearchEvent` | Emits `{trigger, query}` whenever the active query changes — drive async loading. |
| `mentionSelect` | `MkMentionSelectEvent` | Emits after an option has been inserted into the control. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listId` | `string` | Id of the listbox panel, wired to `aria-controls` while open. |

### MkOnScreenKeyboardTrigger (directive)

Selector: `input[mkOnScreenKeyboardFor], textarea[mkOnScreenKeyboardFor]` · exportAs: `mkOnScreenKeyboardTrigger`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/touch-keys

Import: `import { MkOnScreenKeyboardTrigger } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Binds an `<input>`/`<textarea>` to an `MkOnScreenKeyboard`: opens the
panel on focus/click, closes it when focus leaves, and sets
`inputmode="none"` so touch devices don't raise the OS keyboard on top of
it. Disabled/readonly fields never open the panel.

```html
<input mkInput [mkOnScreenKeyboardFor]="kbd" />
<mk-on-screen-keyboard #kbd />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mkOnScreenKeyboardFor` (required) | `MkOnScreenKeyboard` |  | The keyboard instance to open for this field. |

```

### mkNipChecksum (function)

Import: `import { mkNipChecksum } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Polish NIP checksum: the weighted sum of the first nine digits modulo 11 is
the tenth (check) digit. A remainder of 10 can never be a digit, so such a
number is invalid whatever its last digit.

```ts
function mkNipChecksum(compact: string): boolean
```

### mkPostalCodeValidator (function)

Reactive-forms validator for a postal code in a given country. Empty values

format pass everything.

```ts

```

```ts
function mkPostalCodeValidator(country: string, formats?: readonly MkPostalFormat[]): ValidatorFn

| `base` | `readonly (readonly MkKeyboardKey[])[]` | Letter layer. |

| `shiftMap`? | `Readonly<Record<string, string>> \| undefined` | Overrides for shifted characters; missing keys fall back to `toUpperCase()`. |

### MkPhoneCountry (interface)

Import: `import { MkPhoneCountry } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Per-country dialing metadata for `MkPhoneInput`.

`mask` is an `mkApplyMask`-style pattern for the **national** number
(`0` = digit, everything else is a literal). Masks follow the most common
national formatting; countries with several plan lengths use their longest
common mobile format. The set covers the countries an admin product is
likely to meet — extend or replace it via the `countries` input.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase (drives the flag + display name). |
| `dialCode` | `string` | International dialing code, digits only (no `+`). |
| `mask` | `string` | Mask for the national number, `0` = digit. |

### MkPhoneValue (interface)

Import: `import { MkPhoneValue } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Structured value emitted by `MkPhoneInput` in `parts` mode.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | `string` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. `PL`. |
| `dialCode` | `string` | Dialing prefix with the leading `+`, e.g. `+48`. |
| `national` | `string` | National number, digits only. |
| `e164` | `string` | The full E.164 number, e.g. `+48601234567`. |

### MkPostalFormat (interface)

Import: `import { MkPostalFormat } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Per-country postal-code formats for `MkPostalCodeInput`.

`mask` is an `mkApplyMask`-style pattern (`0` = digit, `A` = letter,
`*` = alphanumeric, everything else a literal). `pattern` validates the
complete formatted value. Countries whose codes vary too much for a fixed
mask (e.g. GB) omit `mask` and rely on `pattern` + uppercasing alone.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase. |
| `mask`? | `string \| undefined` | Input mask; omitted for free-form (variable-length) codes. |
| `pattern` | `RegExp` | Regex the complete formatted value must match to be valid. |
| `example` | `string` | Example of a valid code, used as the default placeholder. |

### MkTaxIdFormat (interface)

Import: `import { MkTaxIdFormat } from '@mk-kit/ui/forms';`

Per-country business tax-identifier format for `MkTaxIdInput`.

`mask` is an `mkApplyMask` pattern (`0` = digit; every built-in format is
digits only). `compact` validates the unmasked value — the form value —
and `validate` adds the national checksum where one exists and is
unambiguous. Formats without a `validate` are pattern-checked only.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | `string` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase. |
| `label` | `string` | Local name of the identifier, e.g. `NIP`. |
| `mask` | `string` | Input mask; `0` = digit. |
| `compact` | `RegExp` | Regex the complete unmasked (compact) value must match. |
| `example` | `string` | Example of a valid identifier, used as the default placeholder. |
| `validate`? | `((compact: string) => boolean) \| undefined` | National checksum over the compact value; omitted when there is none. |

## @mk-kit/ui/datetime

37 exports. `import { … } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

### MkCalendar (component)

Selector: `mk-calendar` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkCalendar } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

Calendar — an accessible month-grid date picker following the WAI-ARIA
grid / date-picker pattern. It is the reusable core behind
`mk-date-picker` and `mk-date-range-picker`.

Keyboard (when a day has focus): Arrow keys move by day/week (crossing month
boundaries updates the view), Home/End jump to the start/end of the week,
PageUp/PageDown change month, Shift+PageUp/PageDown change year, and
Enter/Space selects the focused day. A roving tabindex keeps a single tab
stop. Month changes are announced via `MkLiveAnnouncer`.

Exposes a two-way `value` model and implements `ControlValueAccessor`, so it
also works directly with `ngModel` / `formControl` (single-date mode).
Additive range inputs (`rangeMode`,
`rangeStart`, `rangeEnd`) let it highlight an in-progress selection without
affecting single-date use; range hosts listen to `dateSelected`.

```html
<mk-calendar [(value)]="date" [min]="minDate" [firstDayOfWeek]="1" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (two-way) | `Date \| null` | `null` | Two-way selected date (single-date mode). |
| `min` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Earliest selectable date (inclusive, day granularity). |
| `max` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Latest selectable date (inclusive, day granularity). |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number` | `0` | First column of the week: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the whole calendar. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force the invalid visual + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `disabledDate` | `((d: Date) => boolean) \| null` | `null` | Predicate marking individual days as disabled. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to fill the container instead of sizing to content.  Off by default, because the common host is a date-picker popover that must stay a compact widget. Turn it on when the calendar is laid out as part of a page — a sidebar or a column — where sizing to content leaves the space beside it empty. Cells share the width evenly and `--_cell-size` becomes their minimum rather than their fixed size. |
| `rangeMode` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable range highlighting. Hosts drive selection via `dateSelected`. |
| `rangeStart` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Range start endpoint to highlight (range mode). |
| `rangeEnd` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Range end endpoint to highlight (range mode). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `Date \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `dateSelected` | `Date` | Emitted whenever a (non-disabled) day is activated. |
| `dateHovered` | `Date \| null` | Emitted (in range mode) as the pointer hovers days — the hovered day, or `null` on leave. Lets hosts preview a selection (e.g. a whole-week highlight in `mk-week-picker`). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMinDate` / `mkMaxDate` for a date outside `[min]`/`[max]`, and `mkDateFilter` for one rejected by `[disabledDate]`. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `labelId` | `string` | id of the visible month/year label — wire as the grid's label. |

### MkDatePicker (component)

Selector: `mk-date-picker` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkDatePicker } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

DatePicker — a text field paired with a calendar popover. Type a date (parsed
on blur/Enter) or pick one from the `mk-calendar`. Implements
`ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way `value` model, so it works with
`[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]`.

The calendar opens below the field, closes on Escape / outside click / after
a selection, and wires `aria-expanded` / `aria-haspopup` / `aria-invalid`.
When nested in an `mk-form-field` it adopts the field's id and aria wiring.

```html
<mk-date-picker [(value)]="date" [min]="minDate" clearable />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (two-way) | `Date \| null` | `null` | Two-way selected date. |
| `min` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Earliest selectable date (inclusive). |
| `max` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Latest selectable date (inclusive). |
| `disabledDate` | `((d: Date) => boolean) \| null` | `null` | Predicate marking individual days as disabled (threaded to the calendar). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.selectDate` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `displayFormat` | `string` | `'MMM d, yyyy'` | Pattern used to render the selected date in the field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear button when a date is selected. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid`. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number` | `0` | First column of the calendar week (0 = Sunday). |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `Date \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMinDate` / `mkMaxDate` against the `[min]` and `[max]` inputs. |

### MkDateRangePicker (component)

Selector: `mk-date-range-picker` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkDateRangePicker } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

DateRangePicker — select a start + end date from a single calendar popover.
The first click sets the start, the second sets the end (endpoints are

| `min` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Earliest selectable date (inclusive). |
| `max` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Latest selectable date (inclusive). |
| `disabledDate` | `((d: Date) => boolean) \| null` | `null` | Predicate marking individual days as disabled. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.selectRange` | Placeholder shown when no range is selected. |
| `displayFormat` | `string` | `'MMM d, yyyy'` | Pattern used to render each endpoint. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear button when a range is selected. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid`. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number` | `0` | First column of the calendar week (0 = Sunday). |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `MkDateRange` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkDateRangeIncomplete` for a half-picked range, `mkMinDate` / `mkMaxDate` for ends outside `[min]`/`[max]`, and `mkDateFilter` for an end rejected by `[disabledDate]`. A fully empty range passes; compose with `Validators.required` to reject it. |

### MkDateTimePicker (component)

Selector: `mk-datetime-picker` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkDateTimePicker } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

DateTimePicker — one field for a date **and** a time of day. The panel pairs
an `mk-calendar` with a time list generated from `step`; the value is a
single `Date` carrying both parts in local time (seconds and milliseconds
zeroed). Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way `value` model, so it
works with `[(ngModel)]`, reactive forms and `[(value)]`.

Interaction: picking a day keeps the panel open and — when a value already
exists — moves that value to the new day, preserving its time; picking a
time commits and closes. With no value yet, the day is held until a time is
chosen (so a half-picked datetime is never emitted). Typing also works:
`2026-08-26 14:30`, `2026-08-26T09:05`, `Aug 26, 2026 2:30 pm` and a bare
ISO date (→ midnight) are parsed on Enter/blur.

`min` / `max` bound the whole instant at minute precision: the calendar
greys out days outside the range and the time list hides times outside it
on the boundary days. Validation reports `mkMinDate` / `mkMaxDate`.

When nested in an `mk-form-field` it adopts the field's id and aria wiring.

```html
<mk-datetime-picker [(value)]="startsAt" [step]="15" [min]="now" clearable />
<mk-datetime-picker [(value)]="startsAt" hour12 />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (two-way) | `Date \| null` | `null` | Two-way selected date-time (local; seconds and ms are zero). |
| `min` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Earliest selectable instant (inclusive, minute precision). |
| `max` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Latest selectable instant (inclusive, minute precision). |
| `disabledDate` | `((d: Date) => boolean) \| null` | `null` | Predicate marking individual days as disabled (threaded to the calendar). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.selectDateTime` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `displayFormat` | `string \| null` | `null` | Pattern used to render the value in the field. Defaults to `'MMM d, yyyy HH:mm'`, or `'MMM d, yyyy h:mm a'` when `hour12` is set. |
| `step` | `number` | `30` | Interval between generated time options, in minutes. |
| `hour12` | `boolean` | `false` | Display 12-hour times with AM/PM (the model is a `Date` either way). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear button when a value is selected. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid`. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number` | `0` | First column of the calendar week (0 = Sunday). |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `Date \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMinDate` / `mkMaxDate` against the `[min]` and `[max]` inputs, comparing whole instants at minute precision. |

### MkEventCalendar (component)

Selector: `mk-event-calendar`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkEventCalendar } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

Event calendar — a month-grid scheduler view. Renders a 6×7 grid of day
cells built from `buildMonthMatrix`; each cell lists the events whose
`date` falls on that day as coloured pills, capped at `maxPerDay` with a
"+N more" line for the remainder.

Shares the month-grid rendering, header navigation, and weekday header of
`mk-calendar` but is display-only (no date selection). Exposes the viewed
month as a two-way `viewDate` model plus `dayClick` / `eventClick` outputs.

With `editable`, the week/day time grids additionally support drag-to-move
and drag-to-resize (pointer *and* keyboard — WCAG 2.5.7): times snap to
`snapMinutes` and the would-be range is emitted via `eventMove` /
`eventResize` — the calendar never mutates `events` itself.

```html
<mk-event-calendar [events]="events" [(viewDate)]="month"
  (eventClick)="open($event)" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | `readonly MkCalendarEvent[]` | `[]` | Events to plot onto the grid. |
| `viewDate` (two-way) | `Date` | `new Date()` | Two-way month being viewed (any day within it). Defaults to today. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number` | `0` | First column of the week: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. |
| `maxPerDay` | `number` | `3` | Max event pills per day before collapsing the rest into "+N more". |
| `view` (two-way) | `MkCalendarView` | `'month'` | Presentation: the classic month grid, or a timed `week`/`day` grid. |
| `dayStartHour` | `number` | `8` | First hour shown on the week/day time grid. |
| `dayEndHour` | `number` | `22` | Hour the time grid ends at (exclusive). |
| `editable` | `boolean` | `false` | Week/day views: allow rescheduling events by dragging a pill (move) or its bottom edge (resize end time), by pointer or keyboard. Off by default — without it the grid renders exactly as before (no handles, no ARIA additions, no drag behavior). |
| `snapMinutes` | `number` | `15` | Snap grid (minutes) for drag/keyboard edits; also the minimum duration. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `viewDateChange` | `Date` | Emits when `viewDate` changes (two-way binding). |
| `viewChange` | `MkCalendarView` | Emits when `view` changes (two-way binding). |
| `dayClick` | `Date` | Emitted when a day cell is activated (click / Enter). |
| `eventClick` | `MkCalendarEvent` | Emitted when an event pill is clicked (does not also fire `dayClick`). Mouse-only convenience: the pills are presentational (`aria-hidden`), so keyboard / screen-reader users reach events via the day button — its label announces the day's events and activating it fires `dayClick`. |
| `monthChange` | `Date` | Emitted when the viewed range changes via the prev/next buttons. |
| `slotClick` | `Date` | Week/day view: an empty hour slot was clicked — the slot's start instant. |
| `eventMove` | `MkCalendarEventEdit` | Editable week/day grid: an event pill was dragged (or keyboard-moved) to a new start time and/or day. Carries the would-be `start`/`end` — the calendar does **not** mutate `events`; the consumer owns the data and applies the change, typically:  ```ts onMove = ({ event, start, end }: MkCalendarEventEdit) =>   (this.events = this.events.map((e) =>     e === event ? { ...e, date: start, start, end } : e,   )); ``` |
| `eventResize` | `MkCalendarEventEdit` | Editable week/day grid: the pill's bottom edge was dragged (or Shift+Arrow-resized) — only `end` differs, never below `snapMinutes` of duration. Same consumer-owns-the-data contract as `eventMove`. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `labelId` | `string` | id of the visible month/year label — wired as the grid's label. |

### MkMiniDate (component)

Selector: `mk-mini-date` · exportAs: `mkMiniDate` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkMiniDate } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

MiniDate — a compact, popover-free inline date editor with segmented
day / month / year spin fields (like a native `<input type="date">` but
themed and signal-driven). Each segment is an ARIA `spinbutton`: Arrow
Up/Down step the value (day wraps within the month), Home/End jump to the
segment's minimum/maximum, Arrow Left/Right move between segments, and
typing digits fills the focused segment and auto-advances (OTP-style). Implements `ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way
`value` model over a real `Date | null`.

A non-null `Date` is emitted only when all three segments are set and valid;
the day is clamped to the month's length (e.g. Feb 31 → 28/29) and the
result is clamped to `[min, max]`.

```html
<mk-mini-date [(value)]="date" order="dmy" [min]="minDate" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Minimum selectable date (inclusive). |
| `max` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Maximum selectable date (inclusive). |
| `value` (two-way) | `Date \| null` | `null` | Two-way value — a real `Date`, or `null` while incomplete. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling when standalone. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored inside an `mk-form-field`. |
| `order` | `MkMiniDateOrder` | `'dmy'` | Segment order. |
| `yearMin` | `number` | `1900` | Lowest selectable year (for the year spinbutton range). |
| `yearMax` | `number` | `2100` | Highest selectable year (for the year spinbutton range). |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `Date \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMinDate` / `mkMaxDate` against the `[min]` and `[max]` inputs. |

### MkMonthPicker (component)

### MkTimePicker (component)

Selector: `mk-time-picker` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/date-time

Import: `import { MkTimePicker } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

TimePicker — a 24-hour-canonical time field with an editable input plus a
scrollable list of times generated from `step`. The time itself is always
24h canonical regardless of the `hour12` display. Implements
`ControlValueAccessor` and a two-way `value` model.

The form value is either a `HH:mm` string (`"14:30"`, default) or a `Date`
carrying the time in its **local** hours/minutes (`valueFormat="date"`, for
hosts whose model is a datetime — e.g. migrating off Material's
`mat-timepicker`); both modes read back either shape and `null` when empty.
Only the *emitted* value depends on `valueFormat` — internally the time is
always normalised to `HH:mm`, which is also what `min` / `max` compare.

In `date` mode seconds and milliseconds are zeroed, and the **date part** is
taken from the current model value when that is already a `Date` (so editing
the time repeatedly never drifts the day); otherwise today's local date is
used. Assign a `Date` first if the day matters.

Type a time (`14:30`, `2:30 pm`) or pick from the ARIA listbox
(Up/Down/Home/End/Enter/Esc; the active option scrolls into view). When
nested in an `mk-form-field` it adopts the field's id and aria wiring.

```html
<mk-time-picker [(value)]="time" [step]="15" hour12 clearable />
<mk-time-picker valueFormat="date" [(value)]="pickupAt" [step]="15" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (two-way) | `string \| Date \| null` | `null` | Two-way selected time: a canonical `HH:mm` (24h) string, a `Date` when `valueFormat="date"`, or `null`. Either shape may be assigned in either mode; it is normalised to the configured format. |
| `valueFormat` | `"string" \| "date"` | `'string'` | Shape of the form value: a `HH:mm` string or a `Date`. |
| `min` | `string \| null` | `null` | Earliest selectable time `HH:mm` (inclusive). |
| `max` | `string \| null` | `null` | Latest selectable time `HH:mm` (inclusive). |
| `step` | `number` | `30` | Interval between generated options, in minutes. |
| `hour12` | `boolean` | `false` | Display 12-hour time with AM/PM (the model stays 24h). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the control. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.selectTime` | Placeholder shown when empty. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a clear button when a time is selected. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force invalid styling + `aria-invalid`. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string \| Date \| null` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(control: AbstractControl): ValidationErrors \| null` | Reports `mkMinTime` / `mkMaxTime` against the `[min]` and `[max]` inputs. The control value is normalised to `HH:mm` first (so a `Date` model validates too); both sides are then zero-padded `HH:mm`, so a lexicographic compare is a chronological one. |

### formatDate (function)

Import: `import { formatDate } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

Format `date` using a small pattern set. Supported tokens:
`yyyy` (4-digit year), `MMMM` (full month), `MMM` (short month),
`MM` (2-digit month), `dd` (2-digit day), `d` (day), `ddd` (short weekday),
`HH` / `H` (24-hour, padded / bare), `hh` / `h` (12-hour, padded / bare),
`mm` (2-digit minutes) and `a` (`AM` / `PM`). Longer tokens are matched
first so `MMMM` wins over `MM`. Month/weekday names come from `names` when
given, else English.

```ts
function formatDate(date: Date, pattern: string, names?: MkDateNames): string
```

### formatISODate (function)

Import: `import { formatISODate } from '@mk-kit/ui/datetime';`

Format `date` as an ISO calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD` (local time).

```ts
function formatISODate(date: Date): string
```

### MkSortHeader (component)

Selector: `[mkSortHeader]`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/sort

Import: `import { MkSortHeader } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Sort header — attach `mkSortHeader` to a header cell (`<th>`) inside an
element carrying `mkSort`. It wraps the projected header text in a real
`<button>` (so assistive tech hears an operable control), adds a directional
arrow (faint on hover, solid when active), reflects `aria-sort` on the cell,
and toggles the sort on click or Enter/Space.

```html
<th mkSortHeader="email" mkSortHeaderLabel="Email address">Email</th>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mkSortHeader` | `string` | `''` | Column id this header sorts by (the `mkSortHeader` value). |
| `mkSortHeaderStart` | `"asc" \| "desc" \| undefined` | `undefined` | Per-header override for the initial sort direction. |
| `mkSortHeaderDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable sorting for just this header. |
| `mkSortHeaderLabel` | `string` | `''` | Accessible label used in sort announcements (defaults to the id). |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isDisabled` | `Signal<boolean>` | Disabled if this header or the whole `mkSort` is disabled. |
| `isActive` | `Signal<boolean>` | Whether this header is the active, non-cleared sort. |
| `direction` | `Signal<MkSortDirection>` | Active direction, or `none` when this header is not the active sort. |

### MkTable (component)

Selector: `mk-table`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/table

Import: `import { MkTable } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Table — a themed data table built on a native `<table>` for accessibility.
Supply `columns` and `data`; opt into sortable columns, sticky header,
zebra striping, hover and density. Sorting is fully keyboard operable
(Enter/Space on a header) and announces changes via `MkLiveAnnouncer`.

```html
<mk-table
  [columns]="columns"
  [data]="rows()"
  stickyHeader
  zebra
  (sortChange)="onSort($event)"
  (rowClick)="open($event)" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` (required) | `MkTableColumn<T>[]` |  | Column definitions (order = display order). |
| `data` | `T[]` | `[]` | Row objects to render. |
| `stickyHeader` | `boolean` | `false` | Pin the header to the top of the scroll container. |
| `zebra` | `boolean` | `false` | Alternate row background for readability. |
| `hover` | `boolean` | `true` | Highlight rows on hover. |
| `density` | `MkTableDensity` | `'comfortable'` | Row density. |
| `stackAt` | `number` | `0` | Width in px below which each row renders as a CARD instead of a table row. `0` (default) never stacks.  Measured on the table's own container, not the viewport — a table in a narrow sidebar should stack on a desktop, and a table on a tablet in landscape should not. Per-column behaviour is set with `MkTableColumn.stack`.  A grid cannot survive a phone: eight columns become eight unreadable slivers, and horizontal scrolling loses the row you were reading. Cards keep one record together and put its header beside each value. |
| `clickableRows` | `boolean` | `false` | Style rows as clickable and emit `rowClick`. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `this.i18n.noData` | Message shown when there are no rows. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Render a leading checkbox column for row selection. |
| `selected` (two-way) | `T[]` | `[]` | Two-way bound array of selected rows. Use `[(selected)]` to bind, or read `selectionChange`. Rows are compared by `trackKey` when set, else by referential identity. |
| `trackKey` | `string \| undefined` |  | Property name identifying a row for selection equality. When omitted rows are matched by reference. |
| `rowClass` | `((row: T) => string \| null \| undefined) \| null` | `null` | Optional per-row CSS class: called with each row, the returned string is appended to the row's class list (falsy → none). For state the consumer owns — an "active in the side panel" highlight, an unread accent — that `selectable`'s own selected style doesn't cover. |
| `expandable` | `boolean` | `false` | Render a leading expander column. Each row can reveal a detail panel supplied via an `<ng-template mkTableRowDetail let-row>`. |
| `singleExpand` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow only one row expanded at a time (accordion). |
| `resizableColumns` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable drag-to-resize on columns marked `resizable` (data-grid pro). |
| `reorderableColumns` | `boolean` | `false` | Enable drag-to-reorder of column headers (data-grid pro). |
| `groupBy` | `string \| ((row: T) => unknown) \| null` | `null` | Group rows by a column key or an accessor. Renders a collapsible group header row (sticky, with a row count) above each group. Sorting still applies within groups; groups follow their first row's sorted position. |
| `groupLabel` | `((value: unknown, rows: T[]) => string) \| null` | `null` | Formats a group header label; defaults to `String(value)`. |
| `childrenKey` | `string \| null` | `null` | Tree rows: the property on each row holding its child rows (`T[]`). When set, the table renders a tree grid — child rows are indented under their parent behind an expand toggle in the first column, sorting applies per sibling group, and ArrowRight / ArrowLeft on a row open / close it. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedChange` | `T[]` | Emits when `selected` changes (two-way binding). |
| `sortChange` | `MkSortChange` | Emitted when the sort column/direction changes. |
| `rowClick` | `T` | Emitted when a row is clicked (enable via `clickableRows`). |
| `selectionChange` | `T[]` | Emitted with the new selection whenever it changes (enable via `selectable`). |
| `expandedChange` | `T[]` | Emitted with the currently expanded rows whenever they change. |
| `columnResize` | `MkColumnResize` | Emitted when a column is resized (px). |
| `columnReorder` | `string[]` | Emitted with the new column key order after a reorder. |
| `cellEdit` | `MkCellEdit<T>` | Emitted when an inline-editable cell is saved. |
| `groupToggle` | `MkGroupToggle` | Emitted when a group header is expanded or collapsed. |
| `treeToggle` | `MkTreeToggle<T>` | Emitted when a parent row is expanded or collapsed (tree mode). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `isTreeExpanded(row: T): boolean` | Whether a parent row's children are currently shown (tree mode). |
| `toggleTreeRow(row: T, event?: Event): void` | Show or hide a parent row's children (tree mode). |
| `expandAllRows(): void` | Expand every parent row (tree mode). |
| `collapseAllRows(): void` | Collapse every parent row (tree mode). |
| `exportCsv(options?: MkTableExportOptions): string` | The table's rows as CSV: current column order, column formatters applied, sorted the way they are shown, tree children flattened under their parent whether or not they are expanded. Downloads the file (default name `table.csv`) and returns the text. |
| `collapseAllGroups(): void` | Collapse every group. |
| `expandAllGroups(): void` | Expand every group. |

### MkSort (directive)

Selector: `[mkSort]` · exportAs: `mkSort`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/sort

Import: `import { MkSort } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Sort coordinator — apply `mkSort` to a table (or any container) to track
which column is sorted and in which direction. It holds no data: register
headers with `mkSortHeader`, then re-sort your rows in the
`(mkSortChange)` handler. Mirrors the Angular Material `matSort` model but
signal-based.

Clicking a header cycles asc → desc → unsorted (set `mkSortDisableClear` to
cycle asc ↔ desc only). `mkSortStart` flips the initial direction.

```html
<table mkSort mkSortActive="name" mkSortDirection="asc"
       (mkSortChange)="sortData($event)">
  <thead><tr>
    <th mkSortHeader="name">Name</th>
    <th mkSortHeader="size" mkSortHeaderStart="desc">Size</th>
  </tr></thead>
  …
</table>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` (two-way) | `string` | `''` | Id of the currently sorted column (two-way; empty when unsorted). |
| `direction` (two-way) | `MkSortDirection` | `'none'` | Current sort direction (two-way). |
| `mkSortStart` | `"asc" \| "desc"` | `'asc'` | Direction the first click on a header applies. Default `asc`. |
| `mkSortDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable sorting for every header. |
| `mkSortDisableClear` | `boolean` | `false` | Remove the "unsorted" step so headers cycle asc ↔ desc only. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `activeChange` | `string` | Emits when `active` changes (two-way binding). |
| `directionChange` | `MkSortDirection` | Emits when `direction` changes (two-way binding). |
| `sortChange` | `MkSortState` | Emits the new sort state whenever a header is activated. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sort(header: MkSortable): void` | Advance the sort state for the given header (called on click/keyboard). |
| `isActive(id: string): boolean` | Whether the given column id is the active, non-cleared sort. |

### MkTableCell (directive)

Selector: `[mkTableCell]`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/table

Import: `import { MkTableCell } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Marks an `<ng-template>` as the renderer for one column's cells, named by the
column `key`. Without it a cell can only be text — `MkTableColumn.format`
returns a string — so anything richer (a status tag, an avatar, a progress
bar, an action button) meant abandoning `mk-table` for a hand-rolled
`<table>`.

The value is the template's implicit context and the row is available as
`let-row`:

```html
<mk-table [columns]="cols" [data]="rows()">
  <ng-template mkTableCell="status" let-value let-row="row">
    <mk-tag [tone]="toneFor(value)">{{ label(value) }}</mk-tag>
  </ng-template>
</mk-table>
```

A column with both a template and a `format` uses the template; `format`
still applies to sorting/export paths that need a string.

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mkTableCell` (required) | `string` |  | Column key whose cells this template renders. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `TemplateRef<MkTableCellContext<T>>` | The projected template, rendered once per cell in that column. |

### MkTableRowDetail (directive)

Selector: `[mkTableRowDetail]`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/table

Import: `import { MkTableRowDetail } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Marks an `<ng-template>` as the expandable detail content for `MkTable`
rows. The template's implicit context is the row object, so consumers can
destructure it with `let-row`:

```html
<mk-table [columns]="cols" [data]="rows()" expandable>
  <ng-template mkTableRowDetail let-row>
    <dl>… {{ row.notes }} …</dl>
  </ng-template>
</mk-table>
```

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `TemplateRef<{ $implicit: T; }>` | The projected detail template, rendered once per expanded row. |

### MkTableDataSource (class)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/table#data-source

Import: `import { MkTableDataSource } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Server-side data adapter for `mk-table` — the page/sort/filter plumbing every
admin screen otherwise hand-rolls. A plain class (no component, no injection
required): give it a fetcher and bind its signals; every setter re-queries
the server and **stale responses never overwrite newer state** (latest-wins).

- `setFilter` is debounced (default 300 ms); page, sort and page size load
  immediately. Sort, filter and page-size changes reset to page 1.
- `rows` keeps its previous value while loading and on error, so the table
  never blanks mid-transition; `error` is cleared by the next successful
  load.
- Created in an injection context (a component field initialiser) it hooks
  `DestroyRef` and cleans up automatically; anywhere else, call
  `destroy` yourself.

```ts
interface User { id: number; name: string; email: string; }

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `setPage(page: number): void` | Jump to a 1-based page and load it immediately. |
| `setPageSize(size: number): void` | Change the page size; resets to page 1 and loads immediately. |
| `setSort(sort: MkSortState \| MkSortChange \| null): void` | Change the sort; resets to page 1 and loads immediately. Accepts either the `mkSort` directive's `MkSortState` or `mk-table`'s `MkSortChange` payload; a cleared sort (`direction: 'none'` or an empty column id) normalises to `null`. A no-op when the sort is unchanged. |
| `setFilter(query: string): void` | Change the free-text filter. The `filter` signal updates (and the page resets to 1) immediately, but the request is debounced — `refresh()` flushes it early. A no-op when the query is unchanged. |
| `setQuery(query: MkQueryGroup \| null): void` | Set (or clear with `null`) the structured query from `mk-query-builder`. Empty groups and unfinished rules are dropped before the request; a query with nothing left is sent as `null`. Resets to page 1 and loads at once. |
| `refresh(): void` | Re-run the current request immediately (e.g. after a mutation). Flushes a pending debounced filter, since the request reads the live filter value. |
| `connectSort(sort: MkSort): void` | Pipe an `mkSort` directive's changes into `setSort`. Idempotent per directive instance; all subscriptions are released by `destroy`. |
| `destroy(): void` | Cancel pending work: the debounce timer, any in-flight Observable fetch, and `connectSort` subscriptions. In-flight Promise settles are discarded. Called automatically on host destroy when created in an injection context. |

Properties:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `Signal<T[]>` | Rows of the current page (`[]` until the first load lands). |
| `total` | `Signal<number>` | Total row count across all pages (feed to `mk-pagination`'s `total`). |
| `loading` | `Signal<boolean>` | True while the LATEST request is in flight. |
| `error` | `Signal<unknown>` | The last load's error, or `null`; cleared by the next successful load. |
| `page` | `Signal<number>` | Current 1-based page. |
| `pageSize` | `Signal<number>` | Current page size. |
| `sort` | `Signal<MkSortState \| null>` | Current sort, or `null` when unsorted. |
| `filter` | `Signal<string>` | Current filter query (updates immediately, even while debouncing). |
| `query` | `Signal<MkQueryGroup \| null>` | Current structured query, or `null`. |
| `empty` | `Signal<boolean>` | True when a settled load reported no rows at all. |

### mkDownloadText (function)

Import: `import { mkDownloadText } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Trigger a browser download of `text` as a file. No-op outside a DOM
(server-side rendering); returns whether a download was started.

```ts
function mkDownloadText(text: string, filename: string, type?: string): boolean
```

### mkExportCsv (function)

Import: `import { mkExportCsv } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Serialise `rows` as CSV and download it. Returns the CSV text so callers
can also keep it (tests, previews, uploads).

```ts
function mkExportCsv<T>(rows: readonly T[], columns?: readonly MkCsvColumn<T>[], options?: MkCsvExportOptions): string
```

### mkToCsv (function)

Import: `import { mkToCsv } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Serialise `rows` as CSV text.

Without `columns` every key of the first row is exported in its own order.
Column formatters are applied, so what the user saw in the table is what
lands in the file.

```ts
function mkToCsv<T>(rows: readonly T[], columns?: readonly MkCsvColumn<T>[], options?: MkCsvOptions): string
```

### MkCsvOptions (interface)

Import: `import { MkCsvOptions } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `delimiter`? | `string \| undefined` | Field separator (default `,`; use `;` for locales whose Excel expects it). |
| `header`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Emit the header row first (default `true`). |
| `newline`? | `string \| undefined` | Line terminator (default `\r\n`, per RFC 4180). |
| `bom`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Prefix a UTF-8 byte-order mark (default `true`) so Excel reads accented characters correctly. Only affects the downloaded file / returned text. |
| `sanitize`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Neutralise spreadsheet formula injection (default `true`): a text cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or CR is prefixed with `'` so a malicious value cannot execute when opened in Excel / Sheets. Numbers are never touched, so `-5` stays `-5`. |
| `childrenKey`? | `string \| undefined` | Property holding child rows; when set, trees are flattened depth-first. |

### MkTableColumn (interface)

Import: `import { MkTableColumn } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Column definition for `MkTable`.

Members:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Property key on each row object supplying the cell value. |
| `header` | `string` | Visible column header text. |
| `sortable`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Allow sorting by this column. |
| `align`? | `MkTableAlign \| undefined` | Cell/header alignment (default `start`). |
| `width`? | `string \| undefined` | Fixed column width (any CSS length). |
| `format`? | `((value: unknown, row: T) => string) \| undefined` | Optional formatter turning the raw value into display text. |
| `resizable`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Allow the user to drag-resize this column (needs `resizableColumns`). |
| `editable`? | `boolean \| undefined` | Make this column's cells inline-editable (double-click / Enter). |
| `pinned`? | `"left" \| "right" \| undefined` | Pin (freeze) this column to a side while the body scrolls horizontally. |
| `minWidth`? | `number \| undefined` | Minimum width in px when resizing (default 60). |
| `stack`? | `"title" \| "footer" \| "hide" \| undefined` | What becomes of this column when the table stacks into cards (see `MkTable.stackAt`). Omitted, the column renders as a labelled field: its `header` on one side, its value on the other.  - `'title'` — the card's heading. No label; the value identifies the   record at a glance (an order number, a product name). Mark one, or two   if something short belongs beside it such as a status or a total. - `'footer'` — pinned to the bottom of the card, full width and unlabelled.   Where an actions cell belongs: buttons read as buttons, rather than as   the answer to a label. - `'hide'` — not rendered at all. Not merely invisible: the cell is never   created, so a screen reader does not read it either. For columns that   only earn their place while scanning a grid, and especially for anything   an expandable row detail already repeats. |

### MkDataFetcher (type)

Import: `import { MkDataFetcher } from '@mk-kit/ui/table';`

Loads one page of data for a `MkDataRequest`. May return a `Promise`
(e.g. `fetch`) or an `Observable` (e.g. `HttpClient`); an Observable is
treated as single-shot — the first emission wins and the subscription is
released.

```ts
type MkDataFetcher<T> = ( req: MkDataRequest, ) => Promise<MkDataPage<T>> | Observable<MkDataPage<T>>;
```

### MkAvatar (component)

Selector: `mk-avatar`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/badges-avatars

Import: `import { MkAvatar } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

Avatar — a user/entity image that gracefully falls back to initials derived
from `name`, or to a projected icon. The whole avatar is exposed as a single
labelled image to assistive tech.

```html
<mk-avatar name="Ada Lovelace" src="/ada.jpg" status="online" />
<mk-avatar name="Grace Hopper" />          <!-- initials fallback -->
<mk-avatar><svg>…</svg></mk-avatar>        <!-- icon fallback -->
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string \| undefined` |  | Image URL. When it fails to load the avatar falls back automatically. |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` |  | Display name; drives the initials fallback and the default alt text. |
| `alt` | `string \| undefined` |  | Explicit accessible label. Defaults to `name`, else "Avatar". |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Size scale. |
| `shape` | `MkAvatarShape` | `'circle'` | Outline shape. |
| `status` | `MkAvatarStatus \| undefined` |  | Presence indicator dot; omit for none. |

### MkBarChart (component)

Selector: `mk-bar-chart`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/charts

Import: `import { MkBarChart } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

BarChart — compares a measure across categories with one or more series
(grouped or `stacked`), `vertical` (default) or `horizontal`. Dependency-free
SVG on the validated `--mk-chart-*` palette; ships a legend for ≥ 2 series, a
value axis with gridlines, per-bar hover tooltips and a screen-reader table.

```html
<mk-bar-chart orientation="horizontal"
  [categories]="['Q1','Q2','Q3','Q4']"
  [series]="[{ name: 'Revenue', data: [12,19,15,22] }]" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Category labels along the category axis. |
| `series` | `readonly MkChartSeries[]` | `[]` | One or more data series (values align to `categories`). |
| `orientation` | `MkBarOrientation` | `'vertical'` | Bar direction. |
| `width` | `number` | `480` | Intrinsic width in viewBox units — the fallback before the host is measured, and the fixed drawing width when `responsive` is off. |
| `responsive` | `boolean` | `true` | Match the viewBox width to the host's actual width so `height` means pixels and a wide container no longer stretches the chart vertically. Set false to pin the drawing to `width` (the pre-0.8 behaviour). |
| `height` | `number` | `260` | Intrinsic height. |
| `stacked` | `boolean` | `false` | Stack series into one bar per category instead of grouping. |
| `showGrid` | `boolean` | `true` | Show gridlines behind the bars. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Force the legend on/off (defaults to on when there are ≥ 2 series). |
| `labelAngle` | `number \| "auto"` | `'auto'` | Category-label tilt in degrees. `'auto'` (the default) leaves labels flat while they fit and tilts them 45° when they would collide — the axis of a narrow chart is otherwise an unreadable smear. A number pins the angle (0 = always flat, 30/45 = always tilted); values are clamped to 0…90.  Tilting reserves the extra vertical room it needs, so `height` still means the height you asked for. When even tilted labels cannot fit, the chart thins them — every Nth label is dropped rather than overlapped. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible summary; generated from the data when omitted. |

### MkCalendarHeatmap (component)

Selector: `mk-calendar-heatmap`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/charts

Import: `import { MkCalendarHeatmap } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

Calendar heatmap — a GitHub-style year of daily squares: weeks as columns,
weekdays as rows, each day shaded by its value. Rendered as a semantic
`<table>` (month headers span their week columns, weekday names are row
headers, every cell carries its formatted value for screen readers) with
intensities mixed from `color` over the surface via `color-mix`, so it
tracks the theme. Values are bucketed linearly against the range maximum
into `levels` steps; days with value 0 (or no entry) render transparent.

Shows the last 12 months ending today by default; set `year` for a fixed
calendar year.

```html
<mk-calendar-heatmap
  [data]="contributions"
  [year]="2026"
  (cellClick)="openDay($event.date)"
/>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `readonly MkCalendarHeatmapEntry[]` | `[]` | The daily values. Days without an entry count as 0. |
| `year` | `number \| null` | `null` | Show a fixed calendar year; unset shows the last 12 months ending today. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number` | `1` | First weekday of the columns: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. |
| `color` | `string` | `'var(--mk-primary)'` | Base colour mixed over the surface for intensity. |
| `levels` | `number` | `5` | Number of intensity buckets in the ramp. |
| `format` | `((date: Date, value: number) => string) \| null` | `null` | Formatter for each cell's title / screen-reader text (and legend max). |
| `showScale` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the less→more colour ramp legend. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible summary; generated from the data when omitted. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cellClick` | `MkCalendarHeatmapCell` | Emits the clicked day and its value. |

### MkCarousel (component)

Selector: `mk-carousel`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/data

Import: `import { MkCarousel } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

Carousel — an accessible slides/gallery. Project slides marked with
`mkCarouselSlide`; get prev/next arrows, dot indicators, Arrow-key
navigation, pointer swipe (touch or mouse drag; vertical page scroll stays
native) and optional autoplay that pauses on hover/focus. The current slide
is a two-way `index` model.

```html
<mk-carousel ariaLabel="Featured" autoplay>
  <div mkCarouselSlide>…</div>
  <div mkCarouselSlide>…</div>
</mk-carousel>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` (two-way) | `number` | `0` | Two-way current slide index. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.carouselLabel` | Accessible label for the carousel region. |
| `loop` | `boolean` | `true` | Wrap around at the ends. |
| `showDots` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the dot indicators. |
| `showArrows` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the prev/next arrows. |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Advance automatically. Pauses transiently on hover/focus/pointer-down and shows a persistent pause/play toggle (`userPaused`). Never runs when the user prefers reduced motion. |
| `interval` | `number` | `5000` | Autoplay interval in ms. |
| `userPaused` (two-way) | `boolean` | `false` | Persistent, user-controlled pause (WCAG 2.2.2). Latched by the pause/play toggle; the transient hover/focus pause never overrides it. Two-way so consumers can bind or preset it. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `indexChange` | `number` | Emits when `index` changes (two-way binding). |
| `userPausedChange` | `boolean` | Emits when `userPaused` changes (two-way binding). |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `goTo(i: number): void` | Go to slide `i` (clamped, or wrapped when `loop`). |
| `next(): void` |  |
| `prev(): void` |  |

### MkFunnelChart (component)

Selector: `mk-funnel-chart`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/proportion-charts

Import: `import { MkFunnelChart } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

FunnelChart — decreasing stacked trapezoids visualising conversion through a
sequence of stages. Each band's top width tracks its own value and its bottom
width tracks the next stage's value, so consecutive bands connect into a
funnel. Dependency-free SVG on the validated `--mk-chart-*` palette; each band
is labelled with its value and its conversion relative to the top stage, and a
screen-reader table mirrors the data.

```html
<mk-funnel-chart
  [segments]="[
    { label: 'Visits', value: 1000 },
    { label: 'Signups', value: 400 },
    { label: 'Paid', value: 120 },
  ]" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `segments` | `readonly MkFunnelSegment[]` | `[]` | The funnel stages, ordered largest → smallest conceptually. |
| `width` | `number` | `420` | Intrinsic width (viewBox units; the SVG scales to its container). |
| `height` | `number` | `300` | Intrinsic height. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Force the legend on/off (funnels label each band, so off by default). |
| `showValues` | `boolean` | `true` | Render the value + conversion text on each band. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible summary; generated from the data when omitted. |

### MkGauge (component)

| `size` | `number` | `180` | Intrinsic size (viewBox units; the SVG scales to its container). |
| `thickness` | `number` | `14` | Arc thickness. |
| `color` | `string` | `'var(--mk-primary)'` | Value-arc colour. |
| `trackColor` | `string` | `'var(--mk-border-subtle)'` | Track (background arc) colour. |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Label under the value. |
| `unit` | `string` | `''` | Unit appended to the value (e.g. `%`). |
| `valueText` | `string` | `''` | Override the centred value text. |

### MkInlineEdit (component)

Selector: `mk-inline-edit` · form control (ControlValueAccessor)

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/table

Import: `import { MkInlineEdit } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

InlineEdit — click a piece of text to edit it in place. The display is a
button that swaps to an input on click (or Enter/Space); Enter or blur saves,
Escape reverts. Ideal for editable labels in tables and detail panels.
Implements `ControlValueAccessor` + a two-way `value` model of `string`.

```html
<mk-inline-edit [(value)]="title" placeholder="Untitled" />
<mk-inline-edit multiline [(value)]="notes" />

| `placeholder` | `string` | `this.i18n.empty` | Shown (muted) when the value is empty. |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | `false` | Use a multi-line textarea; Enter inserts a newline, blur/✓ saves. |
| `saveOnBlur` | `boolean` | `true` | Save when the field loses focus (otherwise blur cancels). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `this.i18n.edit` | Accessible label for the edit trigger + field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable editing. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Force the invalid visual + `aria-invalid` when used standalone. |
| `size` | `MkSize` | `'md'` | Control size. Ignored when nested in an `mk-form-field`. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | Emits when `value` changes (two-way binding). |
| `saved` | `string` | Emitted with the new value when an edit is saved. |
| `cancelled` | `void` | Emitted when an edit is cancelled. |

### MkJsonViewer (component)

Selector: `mk-json-viewer` · exportAs: `mkJsonViewer`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/data

Import: `import { MkJsonViewer } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

JsonViewer — a read-only, collapsible tree for JSON-ish data: objects and
arrays fold behind disclosure buttons (with a `{…} n items` preview),
primitives are colour-coded by type, and circular references render as
`[Circular]` instead of recursing. `expandDepth` controls how much is open
initially; `expandAll()` / `collapseAll()` are available on the component.

The complement of `mk-code-editor`: the editor edits JSON text, this
explores JSON *data* (API responses, entity payloads, config dumps).

```html
<mk-json-viewer [data]="response" [expandDepth]="2" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` (required) | `unknown` |  | The value to display (any JSON-serialisable data). |
| `expandDepth` | `number` | `1` | How many levels start expanded (root = level 1). |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `this.i18n.jsonLabel` | Accessible label of the tree region. |

Methods:

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `expandAll(): void` | Expand every object/array node. |
| `collapseAll(): void` | Collapse everything (the root stays visible). |

### MkKanban (component)

Selector: `mk-kanban`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/data

Import: `import { MkKanban } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

Kanban board — a horizontal row of columns whose cards can be dragged and
reordered within a column or transferred between columns. Built on the dnd
group's connected `[mkDropList]` / `[mkDrag]` directives, so it inherits both
pointer and keyboard dragging (WCAG 2.1.1) for free.

Bind `columns` two-way; the model is updated immutably on each drop. Project
an `<ng-template>` to render custom card content — it receives the card as
`$implicit` and the owning column as `column`:

```html
<mk-kanban [(columns)]="board" (cardMoved)="onMoved($event)">
  <ng-template #cardTemplate let-card let-column="column">
    <strong>{{ card.title }}</strong>
  </ng-template>
</mk-kanban>
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` (two-way) | `MkKanbanColumn[]` | `[]` | The board's columns and their cards (two-way). Updated on every drop. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable all dragging on the board. |

Outputs:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columnsChange` | `MkKanbanColumn[]` | Emits when `columns` changes (two-way binding). |
| `cardMoved` | `MkKanbanCardMovedEvent` | Emitted after the model is updated when a card is moved. |

### MkLineChart (component)

Selector: `mk-line-chart`

Docs: https://mk-kit.dev/components/charts

Import: `import { MkLineChart } from '@mk-kit/ui/data';`

LineChart — a line (or `area`) chart for change over time / ordered
categories, with one or more series. Dependency-free SVG on the validated
`--mk-chart-*` palette; ships a legend for ≥ 2 series, a value axis, a
hover crosshair with a shared tooltip, and a screen-reader data table.

```html
<mk-line-chart area
  [categories]="months"
  [series]="[{ name: 'Sessions', data: sessions() }]" />
```

Inputs:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Ordered category labels along the x axis. |
| `series` | `readonly MkChartSeries[]` | `[]` | One or more data series (values align to `categories`). |
| `width` | `number` | `480` | Intrinsic width in viewBox units — the fallback before the host is measured, and the fixed drawing width when `responsive` is off. |
| `responsive` | `boolean` | `true` | Match the viewBox width to the host's actual width so `height` means pixels and a wide container no longer stretches the chart vertically. Set false to pin the drawing to `width` (the pre-0.8 behaviour). |
| `height` | `number` | `260` | Intrinsic height. |
| `area` | `boolean` | `false` | Fill the area under each line. |
| `stacked` | `boolean` | `false` | Stack the series (cumulative bands) — implies filled areas. |
| `showDots` | `boolean` | `false` | Draw a dot at every data point. |
| `showGrid` | `boolean` | `true` | Show gridlines. |
| `showLegend` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Force the legend on/off (defaults to on when there are ≥ 2 series). |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible summary; generated from the data when omitted. |

### MkList (component)
